title.zh: 卷3 帝紀第3 煬帝上
title.raw: 卷3 帝紀第3 煬帝上 Volume 3 Annals 3: Emperor Yang 1

sentences.zh: 煬皇帝諱廣，一名英，小字阿𡡉，高祖第二子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Yang's taboo name was Guang; he had another name, Ying, and a childhood name, A'mo; he was Gaozu's second son.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor Yang's personal name was Guang; he was also called Ying, and as a child went by the name A'mo. He was the second son of Emperor Gaozu.

sentences.zh: 母曰文獻獨孤皇后。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Wenxian of the Dugu clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Wenxian, née Dugu.

sentences.zh: 上美姿儀，少敏慧，高祖及后於諸子中特所鍾愛。

translations.literal: The emperor was handsome in bearing and quick and clever from youth; Gaozu and the empress especially favored him among all their sons.
translations.idiomatic: Handsome in appearance and sharp-witted from boyhood, he was the son whom Gaozu and the empress loved above all the others.

sentences.zh: 在周，以高祖勳，封雁門郡公。

translations.literal: Under Zhou, by virtue of Gaozu's merit, he was enfeoffed as Duke of Yanmen Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: While the Northern Zhou still ruled, he was made Duke of Yanmen Commandery in recognition of Gaozu's achievements.

sentences.zh: 六年，轉淮南道行臺尚書令。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he was transferred to be Director of the Huainan Circuit Executive and Minister Steward.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was reassigned as Director of the Huainan Circuit Executive and Minister Steward.

sentences.zh: 其年，徵拜雍州牧、內史令。

translations.literal: That same year, he was summoned and appointed Governor of Yong Province and Director of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In that same year he was recalled to court and appointed Governor of Yong Province and Director of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八年冬，大舉伐陳，以上為行軍元帥。

translations.literal: In the winter of the eighth year, when a great campaign was launched against Chen, he was made Commander-in-Chief of the field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the eighth year, when the empire launched its great campaign against Chen, he was placed in command of the field army.

sentences.zh: 及陳平，執陳湘州刺史施文慶、散騎常侍沈客卿、市令陽慧朗、刑法監徐析、[3]尚書都令史暨慧，以其邪佞，有害於民，斬之右闕下，以謝三吳。

translations.literal: When Chen was pacified, he seized Chen's Prefect of Xiangzhou Shi Wenqing, Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue Shen Keqing, Market Magistrate Yang Huilang, Supervisor of Penal Law Xu Zhe, and Chief Clerk of the Ministry Secretariat Ji Hui; because they were wicked and flatterers who had harmed the people, he executed them below the Right Watchtower to appease the Three Wu region.
translations.idiomatic: After Chen fell, he had arrested and executed Shi Wenqing, Prefect of Xiangzhou, Shen Keqing, Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue, Market Magistrate Yang Huilang, Supervisor of Penal Law Xu Zhe, and Chief Clerk of the Ministry Secretariat Ji Hui—men whose corruption and flattery had harmed the people—below the Right Watchtower as an act of justice toward the Three Wu.

sentences.zh: 於是封府庫，資財無所取，天下稱賢。

translations.literal: Thereupon he sealed the treasuries and took none of the wealth for himself; the realm acclaimed his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: He then sealed the state treasuries and took nothing for himself, and all under Heaven praised his restraint.

sentences.zh: 進位太尉，賜輅車、乘馬，袞冕之服，玄珪、白璧各一。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Grand Commandant and granted a ceremonial carriage, riding horses, and the robes of the nine symbols, as well as one black jade tablet and one white jade disc each.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Grand Commandant and given a ceremonial carriage, riding horses, the full regalia of rank, a black jade tablet, and a white jade disc.

sentences.zh: 復拜并州總管。

translations.literal: He was again appointed Commander-in-Chief of Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was once more appointed Commander-in-Chief of Bing Province.

sentences.zh: 俄而江南高智慧等相聚作亂，徙上為揚州總管，鎮江都，每歲一朝。

translations.literal: Before long, Gao Zhihui and others in the Jiangnan region gathered and rose in rebellion; the emperor was transferred to be Commander-in-Chief of Yang Province, stationed at Jiangdu, and came to court once each year.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, when Gao Zhihui and others in the south of the Yangzi gathered forces in rebellion, he was made Commander-in-Chief of Yang Province and posted at Jiangdu, returning to court once a year.

sentences.zh: 高祖之祠太山也，領武候大將軍。

translations.literal: When Gaozu performed the feng and shan rites at Mount Tai, he served as General of the Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu performed the feng and shan rites at Mount Tai, he held the post of General of the Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 明年，歸藩。

translations.literal: The following year, he returned to his fief.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he returned to his princely domain.

sentences.zh: 後數載，突厥寇邊，復為行軍元帥，出靈武，無虜而還。

translations.literal: Several years later, when the Turks raided the frontier, he again served as Commander-in-Chief of the field army, marched out from Lingwu, and returned when no enemy was found.
translations.idiomatic: Some years later, when the Turks raided the borders, he again took command of a field army, marched out from Lingwu, and returned after finding no enemy.

sentences.zh: 及太子勇廢，立上為皇太子。

translations.literal: When Crown Prince Yong was deposed, the emperor was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: After Crown Prince Yong was deposed, he was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 是月，當受冊。

translations.literal: That month, he was to receive the investiture.
translations.idiomatic: In that month he was to receive formal investiture as heir.

sentences.zh: 高祖曰：「吾以大興公成帝業。

translations.literal: Gaozu said: "I achieved the imperial enterprise through the Duke of Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu said, "It was through the Duke of Daxing that I achieved the imperial enterprise.

sentences.zh: 」令上出舍大興縣。

translations.literal: " He ordered the emperor to move out and lodge in Daxing County.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered the crown prince to move out and take lodging in Daxing County.

sentences.zh: 其夜，烈風大雪，地震山崩，民舍多壞，壓死者百餘口。

translations.literal: That night, fierce winds and heavy snow struck, the earth quaked and mountains collapsed, many common dwellings were destroyed, and more than a hundred people were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: That night a violent gale and blizzard swept in; the earth shook and mountains gave way, many houses were destroyed, and more than a hundred people were killed.

sentences.zh: 仁壽初，奉詔巡撫東南。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Renshou reign, he received an edict to tour and pacify the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Renshou era he was ordered to tour and pacify the southeast.

sentences.zh: 是後高祖每避暑仁壽宮，恒令上監國。

translations.literal: After this, whenever Gaozu went to Renshou Palace to escape the summer heat, he always ordered the emperor to oversee the government.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, whenever Gaozu retired to Renshou Palace to escape the summer heat, he regularly left the crown prince in charge of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 四年七月，高祖崩，上即皇帝位於仁壽宮。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year, Gaozu died, and the emperor ascended the throne at Renshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year Gaozu died, and he took the throne at Renshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 八月，奉梓宮還京師。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, he escorted the imperial coffin back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he escorted the imperial coffin back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 并州總管漢王諒舉兵反，詔尚書左僕射楊素討平之。

translations.literal: Yang Liang, Commander-in-Chief of Bing Province and Prince of Han, raised troops in rebellion; an edict ordered Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Yang Su to suppress and pacify him.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yang Liang of Han, Commander-in-Chief of Bing Province, rose in rebellion; the emperor ordered Left Vice Director Yang Su to put down the revolt.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，以備身將軍崔彭為左領軍大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day yisi in the ninth month, Palace Guard General Cui Peng was appointed General of the Left Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi of the ninth month, Palace Guard General Cui Peng was made General of the Left Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，幸洛陽。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei in the eleventh month, he visited Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei of the eleventh month he traveled to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 丙申，發丁男數十萬掘塹，自龍門東接長平、汲郡，抵臨清關，度河，至浚儀、襄城，達於上洛，以置關防。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, he mobilized several hundred thousand corvée laborers to dig ditches from Longmen eastward connecting Changping and Ji Commandery, reaching Linqing Pass, crossing the Yellow River to Junyi and Xiangcheng, and extending to Shangluo, in order to establish frontier defenses.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen he conscripted several hundred thousand men to dig defensive ditches from Longmen east through Changping and Ji Commandery to Linqing Pass, then across the Yellow River to Junyi and Xiangcheng and on to Shangluo, establishing a chain of frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔曰：

translations.literal: On the day guichou, an edict stated:
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou an edict proclaimed:

sentences.zh: 乾道變化，陰陽所以消息，沿創不同，生靈所以順叙。

translations.literal: The Way of Heaven transforms; yin and yang thereby wax and wane; institutions of creation differ, and the people thereby find proper order.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's Way is one of change; through yin and yang the seasons advance and retreat. Institutions differ from age to age, yet through them the people find their proper place.

sentences.zh: 若使天意不變，施化何以成四時，人事不易，為政何以釐萬姓！

translations.literal: If Heaven's intent did not change, how could transformation bring forth the four seasons? If human affairs did not change, how could government put the myriad people in order!
translations.idiomatic: If Heaven's intent never changed, how could transformation produce the four seasons? If human affairs never changed, how could government set the myriad people in order?

sentences.zh: 易不云乎：「通其變，使民不倦」；

translations.literal: Does not the Changes say: "By penetrating change, the people are not wearied"?
translations.idiomatic: Does not the Book of Changes say, "By understanding change, one keeps the people from growing weary"?

sentences.zh: 「變則通，通則久。

translations.literal: "Change then penetrates; penetration then endures.
translations.idiomatic: "Change brings penetration; penetration brings endurance.

sentences.zh: 」「有德則可久，有功則可大。

translations.literal: "One with virtue can endure; one with merit can grow great.
translations.idiomatic: "Where there is virtue, endurance follows; where there is merit, greatness follows.

sentences.zh: 」朕又聞之，安安而能遷，民用丕變。

translations.literal: " I have also heard that those who are secure yet able to move cause the people to change greatly.
translations.idiomatic: " I have also heard that when rulers who are secure yet willing to move, the people transform on a grand scale.

sentences.zh: 是故姬邑兩周，如武王之意，殷人五徙，成湯后之業。

translations.literal: Therefore the Zhou moved their capital twice, as King Wu intended, and the Yin people moved five times, completing the enterprise of Tang the Successful.
translations.idiomatic: This is why the Zhou moved their capital twice, as King Wu had wished, and the people of Yin moved five times, completing the work of Tang the Successful.

sentences.zh: 若不因人順天，功業見乎變，愛人治國者可不謂歟！

translations.literal: If one does not follow the people and accord with Heaven, how can merit appear through change? Can one who loves the people and governs the state fail to do so!
translations.idiomatic: Unless one follows the people and accords with Heaven, how can achievement be shown through change? Surely one who loves the people and governs the realm cannot do otherwise!

sentences.zh: 然洛邑自古之都，王畿之內，天地之所合，陰陽之所和。

translations.literal: Yet Luoyang has been a capital since antiquity, within the royal domain, where Heaven and Earth meet and yin and yang harmonize.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang, moreover, has been a capital since antiquity. It lies within the royal domain where Heaven and Earth meet and yin and yang are in harmony.

sentences.zh: 控以三河，固以四塞，水陸通，貢賦等。

translations.literal: Controlled by the Three Rivers and secured by the Four Passes, water and land routes connect, and tribute and taxes are equal.
translations.idiomatic: Guarded by the Three Rivers and fortified by the Four Passes, it is linked by water and land, and tribute flows in from every direction.

sentences.zh: 故漢祖曰：「吾行天下多矣，唯見洛陽。

translations.literal: Therefore Emperor Gaozu of Han said: "I have traveled throughout the realm, and only Luoyang have I seen.
translations.idiomatic: This is why Emperor Gaozu of Han said, "I have traveled throughout the realm, and only Luoyang has truly impressed me.

sentences.zh: 」自古皇王，何嘗不留意，所不都者蓋有由焉。

translations.literal: " Since ancient times, which emperor and king has not paid attention? That they did not make it their capital surely had its reasons.
translations.idiomatic: " From antiquity, which sovereign has not considered it? That they did not establish their capital there surely had its reasons.

sentences.zh: 或以九州未一，或以困其府庫，作洛之制所以未暇也。

translations.literal: Some because the Nine Regions were not yet unified, some because their treasuries were exhausted—the system of building Luoyang therefore had no leisure.
translations.idiomatic: Some because the Nine Regions were not yet united, others because their treasuries were exhausted—for such reasons the plan to build at Luoyang had to wait.

sentences.zh: 我有隋之始，便欲創茲懷、洛，日復一日，越暨于今。

translations.literal: From the beginning of our Sui, I have wished to establish the capital at Huai and Luo; day after day it has continued until now.
translations.idiomatic: From the very founding of our Sui dynasty I have wished to establish a capital at Huai and Luo, and day after day that wish has remained with me until now.

sentences.zh: 念茲在茲，興言感哽！

translations.literal: Thinking of this, dwelling on this, when I speak of it I am moved to grief!
translations.idiomatic: It is always in my thoughts, always on my mind; when I speak of it, grief catches in my throat.

sentences.zh: 朕肅膺寶曆，纂臨萬邦，遵而不失，心奉先志。

translations.literal: I reverently received the imperial calendar and succeeded to the myriad states, following without loss and in my heart serving the prior will.
translations.idiomatic: I reverently received the Mandate and succeeded to rule the myriad states, holding fast to my predecessors' intent without fail.

sentences.zh: 今者漢王諒悖逆，毒被山東，遂使州縣或淪非所。

translations.literal: Now Prince Yang Liang of Han has been rebellious and disloyal, his poison spreading through Shandong, so that districts and counties have fallen where they should not.
translations.idiomatic: Now Prince Yang Liang of Han has rebelled in treachery, and his poison has spread through Shandong until districts and counties have fallen out of our grasp.

sentences.zh: 此由關河懸遠，兵不赴急，加以并州移戶復在河南。

translations.literal: This is because the passes and rivers are distant and suspended, and troops cannot arrive in urgency; moreover, the households moved from Bing Province are again in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: This is because the frontier passes and rivers lie too far away for troops to arrive in time; moreover, the households transferred from Bing Province are once again settled in Henan.

sentences.zh: 周遷殷人，意在於此。

translations.literal: When Zhou moved the people of Yin, the intent lay here.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhou moved the people of Yin, their intent was precisely this.

sentences.zh: 況復南服遐遠，東夏殷大，因機順動，今也其時。

translations.literal: Moreover, the southern regions are distant, and the eastern lands are vast; to move with the opportunity and follow the times—now is the moment.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the southern domains lie far away and the eastern lands are vast; to act when the moment presents itself—now is that moment.

sentences.zh: 羣司百辟，僉諧厥議。

translations.literal: All officials and the hundred ranks unanimously agreed with this deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: All officials of every rank unanimously endorsed this plan.

sentences.zh: 但成周墟塉，弗堪葺宇。

translations.literal: But the ruins of Chengzhou were desolate and could not support construction.
translations.idiomatic: But the ruins of Chengzhou were too desolate to support new construction.

sentences.zh: 今可於伊、洛營建東京，便即設官分職，以為民極也。

translations.literal: Now the Eastern Capital may be built at Yi and Luo; officials and duties should immediately be established, making it the people's pole.
translations.idiomatic: Now an Eastern Capital may be built at Yi and Luo; let officials and offices be established at once, making it the center toward which the people turn.

sentences.zh: 夫宮室之制本以便生，上棟下宇，足避風露，高臺廣厦，豈曰適形。

translations.literal: The system of palaces and dwellings is fundamentally for convenience of life; upper beams and lower eaves suffice to ward off wind and dew—are high towers and broad halls truly suited to form?
translations.idiomatic: Palaces and dwellings exist fundamentally for the convenience of life; beams and eaves are enough to keep out wind and dew—are towering halls and vast pavilions truly what form requires?

sentences.zh: 故傳云：「儉，德之共；

translations.literal: Therefore the tradition says: "Frugality is the common virtue;
translations.idiomatic: Thus the tradition says, "Frugality is the foundation of virtue;

sentences.zh: 侈，惡之大。

translations.literal: extravagance is the greatest evil.
translations.idiomatic: extravagance is the greatest of evils.

sentences.zh: 」宣尼有云：「與其不遜也，寧儉。

translations.literal: " Confucius said: "Rather than lack modesty, better to be frugal.
translations.idiomatic: " Confucius said, "Better to be frugal than to lack modesty.

sentences.zh: 」豈謂瑤臺瓊室方為宮殿者乎，土堦采椽而非帝王者乎？

translations.literal: " Does this mean that only jade towers and jade chambers count as palaces, and that earthen steps and painted rafters do not count as an emperor's dwelling?
translations.idiomatic: " Does this mean that only towers of jade and chambers of jade qualify as palaces, while earthen steps and painted rafters do not suit an emperor?

sentences.zh: 是知非天下以奉一人，乃一人以主天下也。

translations.literal: From this one knows it is not that the realm exists to serve one man, but that one man exists to master the realm.
translations.idiomatic: From this we know that the realm does not exist to serve one man, but that one man exists to govern the realm.

sentences.zh: 民惟國本，本固邦寧，百姓足，孰與不足！

translations.literal: The people are the root of the state; when the root is firm the state is secure; when the common people have enough, who lacks enough!
translations.idiomatic: The people are the root of the state; when the root is firm the state is secure. When the common people prosper, what can the ruler lack?

sentences.zh: 今所營構，務從節儉，無令雕牆峻宇復起於當今，欲使卑宮菲食將貽於後世。

translations.literal: What is now to be built must follow frugality, and carved walls and towering roofs must not rise again in the present age; I wish humble palaces and simple food to be bequeathed to later generations.
translations.idiomatic: What is now to be built must observe frugality. Let no carved walls or soaring roofs rise again in our age; let humble palaces and plain fare be my legacy to later generations.

sentences.zh: 有司明為條格，稱朕意焉。

translations.literal: The responsible officials should clearly set forth regulations in accord with my intent.
translations.idiomatic: Let the responsible officials draw up clear regulations that accord with my intent.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，以右武衞將軍來護兒為右驍衞大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day yichou in the twelfth month, Right Martial Guard General Lai Huer was appointed General of the Right Martial Cavalry Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou of the twelfth month, Right Martial Guard General Lai Huer was made General of the Right Martial Cavalry Guard.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以柱國李景為右武衞大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Pillar of State Li Jing was appointed General of the Right Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, Pillar of State Li Jing was made General of the Right Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 以右衞率周羅睺為右武候大將軍。

translations.literal: Right Guard Commandant Zhou Luohou was appointed General of the Right Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Right Guard Commandant Zhou Luohou was made General of the Right Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 昔者哲王之治天下也，其在愛民乎？

translations.literal: In former times when wise kings governed the realm, was it not in loving the people?
translations.idiomatic: When wise kings of old governed the realm, was their foundation not love for the people?

sentences.zh: 既富而教，家給人足，故能風淳俗厚，遠至邇安。

translations.literal: Once enriched, then they were taught; households provided for and people with enough, therefore customs could be pure and practices thick, reaching the distant and pacifying the near.
translations.idiomatic: First they were enriched, then they were taught. When every household was provided for and every person had enough, customs grew pure and practices deep, and peace extended from the near to the far.

sentences.zh: 治定功成，率由斯道。

translations.literal: When order was settled and achievement completed, all followed this Way.
translations.idiomatic: When order was settled and achievements completed, all followed this path.

sentences.zh: 朕嗣膺寶曆，撫育黎獻，夙夜戰兢，若臨川谷。

translations.literal: I have succeeded to the precious calendar and nurture the black-haired people; morning and night I am vigilant, as if standing at the edge of a ravine.
translations.idiomatic: I have succeeded to the throne and nurture the people; day and night I am vigilant, as though standing on the brink of a chasm.

sentences.zh: 雖則聿遵先緒，弗敢失墜，永言政術，多有缺然。

translations.literal: Although I follow the prior lineage without daring to lose it, in speaking of methods of government there are many deficiencies.
translations.idiomatic: Though I follow my predecessors' path and dare not abandon it, when I consider methods of government I find many gaps.

sentences.zh: 況以四海之遠，兆民之眾，未獲親臨，問其疾苦。

translations.literal: Moreover, with the four seas so distant and the myriad people so numerous, I have not yet been able to visit them in person and inquire into their hardships.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, with the four seas so vast and the myriad people so numerous, I have not yet been able to visit them in person and learn of their hardships.

sentences.zh: 每慮幽仄莫舉，寃屈不申，一物失所，乃傷和氣，萬方有罪，責在朕躬，所以寤寐增歎，而夕惕載懷者也。

translations.literal: I always fear that the secluded and lowly are not promoted, that wrongs and grievances are not redressed, that if one thing loses its place harmony is harmed, that if the myriad regions have guilt the blame lies on my person—this is why I sigh waking and sleeping, and carry vigilance day and night.
translations.idiomatic: I constantly fear that the obscure and humble go unrewarded and that wrongs go unredressed; that if one thing is out of place, harmony is harmed, and if the myriad regions suffer, the blame is mine. This is why I sigh waking and sleeping and carry vigilance through every hour.

sentences.zh: 今既布政惟始，宜存寬大。

translations.literal: Now that government is being deployed at the beginning, magnanimity should be preserved.
translations.idiomatic: Now that my reign is beginning, magnanimity should be preserved.

sentences.zh: 可分遣使人，巡省方俗，宣揚風化，薦拔淹滯，申達幽枉。

translations.literal: Envoys may be dispatched separately to tour and inspect local customs, proclaim and spread civilizing influence, recommend those submerged and stagnant, and convey the secluded and wronged.
translations.idiomatic: Let envoys be dispatched to tour the provinces, proclaim civilizing influence, recommend the overlooked and stagnant, and bring forward the secluded and wronged.

sentences.zh: 孝悌力田，給以優復。

translations.literal: Those filial, fraternal, and diligent in farming shall be granted preferential exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Those who are filial, fraternal, and diligent in farming shall receive preferential tax exemptions.

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，量加振濟。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who cannot support themselves shall be given relief according to measure.
translations.idiomatic: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the destitute who cannot support themselves shall receive relief in proportion to their need.

sentences.zh: 義夫節婦，旌表門閭。

translations.literal: Righteous husbands and chaste wives shall be honored at their gates and lanes.
translations.idiomatic: Men of righteousness and women of chastity shall be honored at their gates and lanes.

sentences.zh: 高年之老，加其版授，並依別條，賜以粟帛。

translations.literal: The aged of advanced years shall receive additional appointment by tablet, and according to separate regulations shall be granted grain and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: The very elderly shall receive honorary appointments by tablet and, according to separate regulations, grants of grain and cloth.

sentences.zh: 篤疾之徒，給侍丁者，雖有侍養之名，曾無賙贍之實，明加檢校，使得存養。

translations.literal: Those with severe illness who are granted attendant laborers—though they have the name of attendants to support them, in reality there is no actual relief—shall be clearly inspected so that they may be preserved and supported.
translations.idiomatic: Those gravely ill who are granted attendant laborers often have the title of support without the reality of relief; let this be strictly inspected so that they may truly be cared for.

sentences.zh: 若有名行顯著，操履修潔，及學業才能，一藝可取，咸宜訪採，將身入朝。

translations.literal: If there are those whose reputation and conduct are prominent, whose integrity is cultivated and pure, and whose learning and talent or single skill are worth taking, all should be sought and gathered and brought to court in person.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone whose reputation and conduct are outstanding, whose integrity is cultivated, or whose learning, talent, or single skill is worth employing should be sought out and brought to court.

sentences.zh: 所在州縣，以禮發遣。

translations.literal: The districts and counties where they are located shall send them off with ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: The districts and counties where they reside shall send them off with proper ceremony.

sentences.zh: 其有蠹政害人，不便於時者，使還之日，具錄奏聞。

translations.literal: If there are those whose corrupt government harms the people and is inconvenient to the times, when the envoys return they shall fully record and memorialize for report.
translations.idiomatic: If any official's corrupt governance harms the people or is unsuitable to the times, the envoys shall fully record it and memorialize upon their return.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以吳州總管宇文㢸為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Commander-in-Chief of Wu Province Yuwen Bi was appointed Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou, Commander-in-Chief of Wu Province Yuwen Bi was made Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，以尚書左僕射楊素為尚書令。

translations.literal: On the day jimao in the second month, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Yang Su was appointed Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao of the second month, Left Vice Director Yang Su was made Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，詔尚書令楊素、納言楊達、將作大匠宇文愷營建東京，徙豫州郭下居人以實之。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei in the third month, an edict ordered Director of the Department of State Affairs Yang Su, Censor-in-Chief Yang Da, and Master Builder for the Palace Yuwen Kai to build the Eastern Capital and move the residents below the walls of Yu Province to fill it.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei of the third month, an edict ordered Director Yang Su, Censor-in-Chief Yang Da, and Master Builder Yuwen Kai to construct the Eastern Capital and relocate residents from below the walls of Yu Province to populate it.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔曰：「聽採輿頌，謀及庶民，故能審政刑之得失。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, an edict stated: "By listening to carriage songs and taking counsel from the common people, one can thereby examine the gains and losses of government and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen an edict stated, "By heeding the songs of the people and taking counsel from the common folk, one can discern the gains and losses of government and punishment.

sentences.zh: 是知昧旦思治，欲使幽枉必達，彝倫有章。

translations.literal: From this one knows that thinking of governance from dawn, one wishes the secluded and wronged to reach expression and the constant norms to have clear pattern.
translations.idiomatic: From this we know that in thinking of governance from dawn, one wishes the secluded and wronged to be heard and the constant norms to stand clear.

sentences.zh: 而牧宰任稱朝委，苟為徼幸以求考課，虛立殿最，不存治實，綱紀於是弗理，寃屈所以莫申。

translations.literal: Yet prefects and shepherds, entrusted by the court with their posts, seek advancement by luck to obtain examination grades, falsely establish rankings of best and worst, do not preserve actual governance, discipline is therefore not ordered, and wrongs and grievances therefore cannot be expressed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet prefects and magistrates, entrusted with their posts by the court, seek advancement through luck in examinations, falsely rank best and worst, neglect actual governance, leave discipline in disorder, and leave wrongs unredressed.

sentences.zh: 關河重阻，無由自達。

translations.literal: Passes and rivers heavily block the way; there is no means of reaching expression on one's own.
translations.idiomatic: Passes and rivers block the way; the people have no means of making themselves heard.

sentences.zh: 朕故建立東京，躬親存問。

translations.literal: I therefore established the Eastern Capital and personally inquire after the people.
translations.idiomatic: I therefore established the Eastern Capital so that I might personally inquire after the people.

sentences.zh: 今將巡歷淮海，觀省風俗，眷求讜言，徒繁詞翰，而鄉校之內，闕爾無聞。

translations.literal: Now I shall tour Huai and the sea, observe and inspect customs, earnestly seek forthright words, yet only verbose documents multiply, while within the village schools nothing is heard.
translations.idiomatic: Now I shall tour the Huai region and the coast to observe local customs and earnestly seek forthright counsel, yet only verbose documents multiply while the village schools fall silent.

sentences.zh: 恇然夕惕，用忘興寢。

translations.literal: Anxiously vigilant at evening, I forget to rise and sleep.
translations.idiomatic: Anxiously vigilant through the evening hours, I forget both rising and sleep.

sentences.zh: 其民下有知州縣官人政治苛刻，侵害百姓，背公徇私，不便於民者，宜聽詣朝堂封奏，庶乎四聰以達，天下無寃。

translations.literal: Among the people, those who know that district and county officials' government is harsh, who harm the common people, who betray the public for private gain and are inconvenient to the people, should be permitted to come to the court hall and submit sealed memorials, so that the Four Listeners may reach expression and the realm have no wrongs.
translations.idiomatic: Among the people, anyone who knows that a district or county official governs harshly, harms the common people, or betrays the public for private gain should be permitted to come to the court hall with a sealed memorial, so that the Four Listeners may hear all and the realm be free of injustice.

sentences.zh: 」又於皁澗營顯仁宮，採海內奇禽異獸草木之類，以實園苑。

translations.literal: " Moreover, at Zaojian the Xianren Palace was built; rare birds, exotic beasts, and plants from within the seas were gathered to fill the gardens and parks.
translations.idiomatic: " Moreover, at Zaojian the Xianren Palace was built, and rare birds, exotic beasts, and plants from throughout the empire were gathered to fill the gardens and parks.

sentences.zh: 徙天下富商大賈數萬家於東京。

translations.literal: Several tens of thousands of wealthy merchants and great traders from throughout the realm were moved to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Several tens of thousands of wealthy merchants and great traders from throughout the realm were relocated to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，發河南諸郡男女百餘萬，開通濟渠，自西苑引穀、洛水達于河，自板渚引河通于淮。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, more than a million men and women from the commanderies of Henan were mobilized to open the Tongji Canal, drawing the Gu and Luo waters from the Western Park to reach the Yellow River, and from Banzhu drawing the river to connect with the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai more than a million men and women from the commanderies of Henan were mobilized to open the Tongji Canal, channeling the Gu and Luo rivers from the Western Park to the Yellow River, and from Banzhu channeling the river to the Huai.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣黃門侍郎王弘、上儀同於士澄往江南採木，造龍舟、鳳艒、[4]黃龍、赤艦、樓船等數萬艘。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Yellow Gate Attendant Wang Hong and Senior Palace Attendant Yu Shicheng were dispatched to the Jiangnan region to gather timber and build dragon boats, phoenix barges, yellow dragon vessels, red warships, tower ships, and several tens of thousands of other vessels.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen, Yellow Gate Attendant Wang Hong and Senior Palace Attendant Yu Shicheng were sent to the Jiangnan region to gather timber and build dragon boats, phoenix barges, yellow dragon vessels, red warships, tower ships, and tens of thousands of other vessels.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，大將軍劉方擊林邑，破之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day guihai, Grand General Liu Fang attacked Linyi and defeated it.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's fourth month, on the day guihai, Grand General Liu Fang struck Linyi and broke its forces.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，民部尚書義豐侯韋沖卒。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu in the fifth month, Wei Chong, Minister of the Household and Marquis of Yifeng, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu of the fifth month, Wei Chong, Minister of the Household and Marquis of Yifeng, passed away.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子，熒惑入太微。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi in the sixth month, the Fire Star entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi of the sixth month, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，制戰亡之家給復十年。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day dingyou, it was decreed that families of those killed in battle should receive ten years of tax exemption.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day dingyou, an edict granted ten years of tax exemption to families of those killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 丙午，滕王綸、衞王集並奪爵徙邊。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Prince Lun of Teng and Prince Ji of Wei both had their titles stripped and were banished to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu, Prince Lun of Teng and Prince Ji of Wei were both stripped of their titles and exiled to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 閏七月甲子，以尚書令楊素為太子太師，安德王雄為太子太傅，河間王弘為太子太保。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi in the intercalary seventh month, Director of the Department of State Affairs Yang Su was appointed Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, Prince Xiong of Ande was appointed Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince, and Prince Hong of Hejian was appointed Grand Protector of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi in the intercalary seventh month, Director Yang Su was made Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, Prince Xiong of Ande Grand Preceptor, and Prince Hong of Hejian Grand Protector.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔曰：

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, an edict stated:
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi an edict proclaimed:

sentences.zh: 君民建國，教學為先，移風易俗，必自茲始。

translations.literal: In ruling the people and establishing the state, teaching comes first; in transforming customs and changing practices, one must begin here.
translations.idiomatic: In ruling the people and founding the state, education comes first; to transform customs and change practices, one must begin here.

sentences.zh: 而言絕義乖，多歷年代，進德修業，其道寖微。

translations.literal: Yet speech has ceased and righteousness has departed; through many years and ages, advancing in virtue and cultivating achievement, its path has gradually faded.
translations.idiomatic: Yet learning has withered and righteousness has departed; over many generations the path of advancing in virtue and cultivating achievement has gradually faded.

sentences.zh: 漢採坑焚之餘，不絕如線，晉承板蕩之運，掃地將盡。

translations.literal: Han gathered what remained after the pit and burning, continuing like a thread; Jin inherited the age of upheaval, sweeping the ground nearly clean.
translations.idiomatic: Han gathered what survived the burning of the books, a thread barely holding; Jin inherited an age of upheaval that nearly swept learning from the earth.

sentences.zh: 自時厥後，軍國多虞，雖復黌宇時建，示同愛禮，函丈或陳，殆為虛器。

translations.literal: From that time onward, military and state affairs had many troubles; though school halls were sometimes built, showing equal love of ritual, and lecterns were sometimes set out, they were nearly empty vessels.
translations.idiomatic: From that time on, military and state affairs brought constant trouble; though school halls were sometimes built in show of reverence for learning, and lecterns sometimes set out, they were nearly empty forms.

sentences.zh: 遂使紆青拖紫，非以學優，製錦操刀，類多牆面。

translations.literal: Thus those with blue cords and purple sashes did not attain them through excellence in learning; those who made brocade yet handled knives were mostly like walls facing one another.
translations.idiomatic: Thus officials with blue cords and purple sashes did not earn their rank through learning; those who should have mastered craft stood instead like blank walls.

sentences.zh: 上陵下替，綱維靡立，雅缺道消，實由於此。

translations.literal: Superiors neglected and inferiors replaced; the net of discipline could not stand; elegance was lacking and the Way vanished—this truly arose from this.
translations.idiomatic: Superiors neglected their duties and inferiors took their place; discipline collapsed, elegance faded, and the Way vanished—all because of this.

sentences.zh: 朕纂承洪緒，思弘大訓，將欲尊師重道，用闡厥繇，講信修睦，敦奬名教。

translations.literal: I have succeeded to the great lineage, thinking to expand the great instruction, wishing to honor teachers and esteem the Way to unfold its path, cultivate trust and harmony, and encourage and reward the teaching of names.
translations.idiomatic: I have succeeded to the great enterprise and seek to expand its great instruction: to honor teachers, esteem the Way, cultivate trust and harmony, and encourage the teaching of virtue.

sentences.zh: 方今宇宙平一，文軌攸同，十步之內，必有芳草，四海之中，豈無奇秀！

translations.literal: Now the universe is unified and writing and tracks are the same; within ten paces there must be fragrant grass; within the four seas, how can there be no exceptional talent!
translations.idiomatic: Now the universe is unified and culture and law are one; within ten paces there must be talent; within the four seas, how can exceptional men be lacking!

sentences.zh: 諸在家及見入學者，若有篤志好古，耽悅典墳，學行優敏，堪膺時務，所在採訪，具以名聞，即當隨其器能，擢以不次。

translations.literal: All those at home and those currently enrolled in schools—if there are those with steadfast will who love antiquity, who delight in the classics, whose learning and conduct are excellent and quick and who can meet the needs of the times—their places should seek and visit them, fully report their names, and they shall immediately be promoted according to their capacity without regard to ordinary order.
translations.idiomatic: All scholars at home and all currently enrolled—if any have steadfast will, love antiquity, delight in the classics, and whose learning and conduct are excellent and suited to the times—let local officials seek them out, report their names, and promote them immediately according to ability, without regard to ordinary rank.

sentences.zh: 若研精經術，未願進仕者，可依其藝業深淺，門蔭高卑，雖未升朝，並量準給祿。

translations.literal: If they refine the classics and do not wish to enter office, according to the depth of their art and the height or lowness of their family privilege, though they have not yet risen at court, salaries shall all be granted by measure.
translations.idiomatic: If they refine the classics but do not wish to enter office, let salaries be granted according to the depth of their learning and the rank of their family privilege, even though they have not yet risen at court.

sentences.zh: 庶夫恂恂善誘，不日成器，濟濟盈朝，何遠之有！

translations.literal: Thus the earnest and good may be guided, and in no long time become vessels; filling court in abundance—how far can that be!
translations.idiomatic: Thus the earnest may be guided and in time become true vessels of state; a court filled with talent—how far off can that be!

sentences.zh: 其國子等學，亦宜申明舊制，教習生徒，具為課試之法，以盡砥礪之道。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Education and other schools should also clearly declare the old system, teach and train students, fully establish methods of examination and testing, to exhaust the path of sharpening.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Education and other schools should also restore the old system, teach and train students, and establish full methods of examination to hone their abilities.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，上御龍舟，幸江都。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the eighth month, the emperor boarded the dragon boat and visited Jiangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin of the eighth month, the emperor boarded his dragon boat and traveled to Jiangdu.

sentences.zh: 以左武衞大將軍郭衍為前軍，右武衞大將軍李景為後軍。

translations.literal: Left Martial Guard General Guo Yan was made vanguard; Right Martial Guard General Li Jing was made rearguard.
translations.idiomatic: Left Martial Guard General Guo Yan was placed in the vanguard and Right Martial Guard General Li Jing in the rearguard.

sentences.zh: 文武官五品已上給樓船，九品已上給黃蔑。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials of the fifth rank and above were given tower ships; those of the ninth rank and above were given yellow boats.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials of the fifth rank and above received tower ships; those of the ninth rank and above received yellow boats.

sentences.zh: 舳艫相接，二百餘里。

translations.literal: Stern to bow connected for more than two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Stern linked to bow, the fleet stretched more than two hundred li.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己丑，赦江淮已南。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jichou, an amnesty was granted south of the Yangtze and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jichou, an amnesty was granted for the region south of the Yangtze and Huai.

sentences.zh: 揚州給復五年，舊總管內給復三年。

translations.literal: Yang Province was granted five years of tax exemption; within the old commandery area, three years of exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Province received five years of tax exemption; within the former commandery area, three years.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，以大將軍崔仲方為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei in the eleventh month, Grand General Cui Zhongfang was appointed Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei of the eleventh month, Grand General Cui Zhongfang was made Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛酉，東京成，賜監督者各有差。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the day xinyou, the Eastern Capital was completed; supervisors were rewarded according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the day xinyou, the Eastern Capital was completed, and supervisors were rewarded according to merit.

sentences.zh: 以大理卿梁毗為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Director of the Court of Judicial Review Liang Pi was appointed Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Court of Judicial Review Liang Pi was made Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，遣十使併省州縣。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, ten envoys were dispatched together to inspect provinces and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao, ten envoys were dispatched jointly to inspect the provinces and counties.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，詔尚書令楊素、吏部尚書牛弘、大將軍宇文愷、內史侍郎虞世基、禮部侍郎許善心制定輿服。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the second month, an edict ordered Director of the Department of State Affairs Yang Su, Minister of Civil Office Niu Hong, Grand General Yuwen Kai, Palace Secretariat Attendant Yu Shiji, and Vice Minister of Rites Xu Shanxin to fix carriages and robes.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu of the second month, an edict ordered Director Yang Su, Minister Niu Hong, Grand General Yuwen Kai, Palace Secretariat Attendant Yu Shiji, and Vice Minister of Rites Xu Shanxin to establish regulations for carriages and robes.

sentences.zh: 始備輦路及五時副車。

translations.literal: The imperial route and the five seasonal secondary carriages were first fully prepared.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial procession route and the five seasonal secondary carriages were fully established for the first time.

sentences.zh: 上常服，皮弁十有二琪，文官弁服，佩玉，五品已上給犢車、通幰，三公親王加油絡，武官平巾幘，袴褶，三品已上給瓟槊。

translations.literal: The emperor's regular dress: leather cap with twelve jade pendants; civil officials' cap dress with jade girdle pendants; fifth rank and above were given calf-drawn carriages and covered canopies; the Three Dukes and imperial princes received oiled nettings; military officials wore flat caps and trousers-jackets; third rank and above were given spears with silk banners.
translations.idiomatic: For regular dress the emperor wore a leather cap with twelve jade pendants; civil officials wore cap dress with jade pirdle ornaments; fifth rank and above received calf-drawn carriages with covered canopies; the Three Dukes and imperial princes received oiled nettings; military officials wore flat caps and riding dress; third rank and above received spears with silk banners.

sentences.zh: 下至胥吏，服色皆有差。

translations.literal: Down to clerks and attendants, dress colors all had distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: Down to clerks and attendants, dress colors were all differentiated by rank.

sentences.zh: 非庶人不得戎服。

translations.literal: Commoners were not permitted military dress.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners were forbidden to wear military dress.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，置都尉官。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Commandant posts were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu, the office of Commandant was established.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，車駕發江都。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu in the third month, the imperial carriage departed Jiangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu of the third month, the imperial carriage departed from Jiangdu.

sentences.zh: 先是，太府少卿何稠、太府丞雲定興盛修儀仗，於是課州縣送羽毛。

translations.literal: Earlier, Vice Director of the Imperial Storehouse He Chou and Assistant Director of the Imperial Storehouse Yun Dingxing had greatly repaired ceremonial regalia; therefore commanderies and counties were ordered to send feathers.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Vice Director He Chou and Assistant Director Yun Dingxing had greatly expanded the ceremonial regalia, and commanderies and counties were ordered to supply feathers.

sentences.zh: 百姓求捕之，網羅被水陸，禽獸有堪氅毦之用者，殆無遺類。

translations.literal: The common people sought to capture them; nets spread over water and land; birds and beasts usable for feathered and fur garments were nearly none left of their kind.
translations.idiomatic: The common people were sent to capture them; nets spread over land and water until birds and beasts usable for feather and fur garments were nearly exterminated.

sentences.zh: 至是而成。

translations.literal: By this time they were completed.
translations.idiomatic: By then the work was complete.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，上自伊闕，陳法駕，備千乘萬騎，入於東京。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day gengxu, the emperor from Yique deployed the law carriage, fully prepared with thousands of chariots and ten thousand riders, and entered the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day gengxu, the emperor departed Yique with the law carriage, thousands of chariots and ten thousand riders in attendance, and entered the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上御端門，大赦，免天下今年租稅。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the emperor ascended the Duan Gate, granted a great amnesty, and exempted the realm from this year's land tax.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai the emperor ascended the Duan Gate, proclaimed a great amnesty, and exempted the realm from that year's land tax.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以冀州刺史楊文思為民部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Prefect of Ji Province Yang Wensi was appointed Minister of the Household.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou, Prefect of Ji Province Yang Wensi was made Minister of the Household.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅，金紫光祿大夫、兵部尚書李通坐事免。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the fifth month, Li Tong, Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and Minister of War, was removed from office for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin of the fifth month, Li Tong, Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and Minister of War, was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: [5]乙卯，詔曰：「旌表先哲，式存饗祀，所以優禮賢能，顯彰遺愛。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, an edict stated: "To honor and mark former sages and thereby preserve sacrificial offerings is to generously treat the worthy and able and clearly display lingering love.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao an edict stated, "To honor former sages and preserve their sacrifices is to generously treat the worthy and clearly display enduring reverence.

sentences.zh: 朕永鑒前修，尚想名德，何嘗不興歎九原，屬懷千載。

translations.literal: I eternally mirror former cultivation and still think of men of virtue—when have I not sighed over the Nine Plains and fixed my thoughts on a thousand years!
translations.idiomatic: I ever mirror the cultivation of former ages and still think of men of virtue—when have I not sighed over those in the Nine Plains and fixed my thoughts on a thousand years!

sentences.zh: 其自古已來賢人君子，有能樹聲立德、佐世匡時、博利殊功、有益於人者，並宜營立祠宇，以時致祭。

translations.literal: From antiquity until now, worthy men and noble gentlemen who were able to establish reputation and virtue, assist the age and correct the times, spread broad benefit and special merit, and benefit the people—all should have temples built and sacrifices offered at the proper seasons.
translations.idiomatic: From antiquity to the present, all worthy men and noble gentlemen who established reputation and virtue, assisted their age, spread broad benefit, and served the people should have temples built and receive sacrifices at the proper seasons.

sentences.zh: 墳壟之處，不得侵踐。

translations.literal: At tombs and mounds, encroachment and trampling are not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: At tombs and burial mounds, encroachment and trampling shall not be permitted.

sentences.zh: 有司量為條式，稱朕意焉。」

translations.literal: The responsible officials should measure and set regulations in accord with my intent."
translations.idiomatic: Let the responsible officials draw up regulations in accord with my intent."

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，以尚書令、太子太師楊素為司徒。

translations.literal: On the day renzi in the sixth month, Director of the Department of State Affairs and Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince Yang Su was appointed Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi of the sixth month, Director and Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince Yang Su was made Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 進封豫章王暕為齊王。

translations.literal: Prince Yan of Yuzhang was advanced and enfeoffed as Prince of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yan of Yuzhang was promoted and enfeoffed as Prince of Qi.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，封皇孫倓為燕王，侗為越王，侑為代王。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao in the eighth month, the emperor's grandsons Tan was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan, Tong as Prince of Yue, and You as Prince of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao of the eighth month, the emperor's grandsons Tan, Tong, and You were enfeoffed as Princes of Yan, Yue, and Dai respectively.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，立秦孝王俊子浩為秦王。

translations.literal: On the day yichou in the ninth month, Hao, son of Prince Jun of Qin Xiao, was established as Prince of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou of the ninth month, Hao, son of Prince Jun of Qin Xiao, was established as Prince of Qin.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，以靈州刺史段文振為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day wuzi, Prefect of Ling Province Duan Wenzhen was appointed Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day wuzi, Prefect of Ling Province Duan Wenzhen was made Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，詔曰：「前代帝王，因時創業，君民建國，禮尊南面。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the twelfth month, an edict stated: "Former dynasties' emperors, according to the times, founded enterprises; in ruling the people and establishing states, ritual honored facing south.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin of the twelfth month an edict stated, "Emperors of former dynasties, according to the times, founded their enterprises; in ruling the people and establishing states, ritual honored the throne facing south.

sentences.zh: 而歷運推移，年世永久，丘壟殘毀，樵牧相趨，塋兆堙蕪，封樹莫辨。

translations.literal: Yet as dynastic fortune shifted and years and ages grew long, mounds and tombs were ruined and destroyed, woodcutters and herders rushed toward one another, burial grounds were choked with weeds, and boundary trees could not be distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Yet as dynastic fortune shifted and ages lengthened, tombs were ruined, woodcutters and herders trampled them, burial grounds choked with weeds, and boundary markers could no longer be distinguished.

sentences.zh: 興言淪滅，有愴于懷。

translations.literal: Speaking of their sinking and extinction, there is grief in the heart.
translations.idiomatic: When I think of their sinking into oblivion, grief fills my heart.

sentences.zh: 自古已來帝王陵墓，可給隨近十戶，蠲其雜役，以供守視。」

translations.literal: Imperial tombs of emperors from antiquity until now may be granted ten nearby households, exempted from miscellaneous corvée, to supply guarding and viewing."
translations.idiomatic: Imperial tombs of emperors from antiquity to the present may be granted ten nearby households, exempt from miscellaneous corvée, to guard and maintain them."

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸亥，勑并州逆黨已流配而逃亡者，所獲之處，即宜斬決。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the day guihai, an order stated that rebels of Bingzhou already exiled who fled should, wherever captured, be immediately beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the day guihai, an order stated that Bingzhou rebels already exiled who fled should, wherever captured, be immediately executed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，長星竟天，出於東壁，二旬而止。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, a long comet filled the heavens, appearing from the Eastern Wall and stopping after twenty days.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi a long comet filled the heavens, appearing from the Eastern Wall and remaining visible for twenty days.

sentences.zh: 是月，武陽郡上言，河水清。

translations.literal: That month, Wuyang Commandery reported that the Yellow River's water was clear.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wuyang Commandery reported that the waters of the Yellow River had turned clear.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，彗星見於奎，掃文昌，歷大陵、五車、北河，入太微，掃帝坐，前後百餘日而止。

translations.literal: On the day jichou in the second month, a comet appeared at Kui, swept through Wenchang, passed Great Tomb, Five Chariots, and North River, entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, swept the Emperor's Seat, and stopped after more than a hundred days.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou of the second month, a comet appeared at Kui, swept through Wenchang, passed Great Tomb, Five Chariots, and North River, entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, swept the Emperor's Seat, and remained for more than a hundred days.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，車駕還京師。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以大將軍姚辯為左屯衞將軍。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Grand General Yao Bian was appointed General of the Left Garrison Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi, Grand General Yao Bian was made General of the Left Garrison Guard.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，遣羽騎尉朱寬使於流求國。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Feathered Cavalry Commandant Zhu Kuan was dispatched as envoy to the kingdom of Liuqiu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou, Feathered Cavalry Commandant Zhu Kuan was sent as envoy to the kingdom of Liuqiu.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，河間王弘薨。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Prince Hong of Hejian died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao, Prince Hong of Hejian died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，詔曰：「古者帝王觀風問俗，皆所以憂勤兆庶，安集遐荒。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day gengchen, an edict stated: "In antiquity emperors observed customs and inquired into practices—all to labor with concern for the myriad people and settle the distant frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day gengchen, an edict stated, "In antiquity emperors observed local customs and inquired into practices—all to labor with concern for the myriad people and settle the distant frontiers.

sentences.zh: 自蕃夷內附，未遑親撫，山東經亂，須加存恤。

translations.literal: Since frontier tribes submitted inward, there has been no leisure to visit and comfort them in person; Shandong has passed through disorder and requires added preservation and relief.
translations.idiomatic: Since frontier tribes submitted, there has been no leisure to visit and comfort them in person; Shandong has suffered disorder and requires added relief.

sentences.zh: 今欲安輯河北，巡省趙、魏。

translations.literal: Now I wish to settle and harmonize Hebei and tour and inspect Zhao and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Now I wish to settle Hebei and tour Zhao and Wei.

sentences.zh: 所司依式。

translations.literal: The responsible offices shall follow the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices shall follow established regulations.

sentences.zh: 」甲申，頒律令，大赦天下，關內給復三年。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, laws and ordinances were promulgated, a great amnesty was granted to the realm, and within the passes three years of tax exemption were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen, laws and ordinances were promulgated, a great amnesty granted to the realm, and three years of tax exemption granted within the passes.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，改州為郡。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, provinces were changed to commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen, provinces were redesignated as commanderies.

sentences.zh: 改度量權衡，並依古式。

translations.literal: Measures, weights, and balances were changed to follow the ancient forms.
translations.idiomatic: Measures, weights, and balances were revised to follow ancient standards.

sentences.zh: 改上柱國已下官為大夫。

translations.literal: Offices from Pillar of State downward were changed to grand masters.
translations.idiomatic: Offices from Pillar of State downward were retitled as grand masters.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔曰：

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, an edict stated:
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu an edict proclaimed:

sentences.zh: 天下之重，非獨治所安，帝王之功，豈一士之略。

translations.literal: The weight of the realm is not settled by governance alone; the achievement of emperors and kings is not the strategy of a single scholar.
translations.idiomatic: The weight of the realm is not borne by governance alone; the achievement of emperors and kings is not the work of a single man.

sentences.zh: 自古明君哲后，立政經邦，何嘗不選賢與能，收採幽滯。

translations.literal: Since antiquity, enlightened rulers and wise emperors, in establishing government and ordering the state—when have they not selected the worthy and able and gathered the submerged and stagnant?
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity, enlightened rulers and wise emperors establishing government and ordering the state—when have they not selected the worthy and gathered the overlooked?

sentences.zh: 周稱多士，漢號得人，常想前風，載懷欽佇。

translations.literal: Zhou was called abundant in scholars; Han was called obtaining men; I constantly think of the former wind and always harbor reverent expectation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou was praised for its abundance of scholars; Han for obtaining true men; I constantly recall that former excellence and harbor reverent expectation.

sentences.zh: 朕負扆夙興，冕旒待旦，引領巖谷，置以周行，冀與羣才共康庶績。

translations.literal: I, bearing the screen, rise early; with crown and tassels wait until dawn; stretch my neck toward cliffs and valleys and place them within the circuit—hoping together with the multitude of talents to jointly bring peace to the myriad achievements.
translations.idiomatic: I rise early at the throne and wait until dawn; I stretch my neck toward cliffs and valleys to place talent within my circuit, hoping together with the multitude of talents to bring peace to the myriad achievements.

sentences.zh: 而彙茅寂寞，投竿罕至，豈美璞韜采，未值良工，將介石在懷，確乎難拔？

translations.literal: Yet gathered thatch is lonely and fishing poles rarely arrive—is it that beautiful jade hides its luster and has not met the good craftsman, or that firm stone is in the heart and is truly hard to pull out?
translations.idiomatic: Yet gathered thatch stands lonely and fishing poles rarely arrive—is it that beautiful jade hides its luster awaiting the good craftsman, or that firm resolve in the heart is truly hard to draw forth?

sentences.zh: 永鑒前哲，憮然興歎！

translations.literal: Eternally mirroring former sages, I am moved to sigh!
translations.idiomatic: Ever mirroring the former sages, I am moved to sigh!

sentences.zh: 凡厥在位，譬諸股肱，若濟巨川，義同舟楫。

translations.literal: All those in office are like arms and legs; if crossing a great river, righteousness is sharing the same boat and oar.
translations.idiomatic: All who hold office are like arms and legs; if crossing a great river, righteousness demands sharing the same boat and oar.

sentences.zh: 豈得保茲寵祿，晦爾所知，優游卒歲，甚非謂也。

translations.literal: How can one preserve such favor and emolument, hide what one knows, idle away the year—it is very much not what should be said.
translations.idiomatic: How can one preserve such favor and salary, hide what one knows, and idle away the year? This is far from what should be.

sentences.zh: 祁大夫之舉善，良史以為至公，臧文仲之蔽賢，尼父譏其竊位。

translations.literal: When Qi Daifu recommended the good, good historians considered it utmost fairness; when Zang Wenzhong concealed the worthy, Confucius criticized him for usurping office.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi Daifu recommended the good, good historians called it utmost fairness; when Zang Wenzhong concealed the worthy, Confucius criticized him for usurping office.

sentences.zh: 求諸往古，非無褒貶，宜思進善，用匡寡薄。

translations.literal: Seeking in former antiquity, there is no lack of praise and blame; one should think to advance the good and thereby correct my thinness.
translations.idiomatic: Seeking in former antiquity, praise and blame are not lacking; one should think to advance the good and thereby strengthen my inadequacy.

sentences.zh: 夫孝悌有聞，人倫之本，德行敦厚，立身之基。

translations.literal: Filial piety and brotherliness with reputation are the root of human relations; thick virtue and conduct are the foundation of establishing the person.
translations.idiomatic: Filial piety and brotherliness with reputation are the root of human relations; solid virtue and conduct are the foundation of the person.

sentences.zh: 或節義可稱，或操履清潔，所以激貪厲俗，有益風化。

translations.literal: Some have integrity and righteousness worth praising, or conduct and integrity pure and clean—thereby stirring against greed and sharpening customs, benefiting civilizing influence.
translations.idiomatic: Some have integrity and righteousness worth praising, or conduct pure and clean—thereby stirring against greed, sharpening customs, and benefiting civilizing influence.

sentences.zh: 強毅正直，執憲不撓，學業優敏，文才美秀，並為廊廟之用，實乃瑚璉之資。

translations.literal: Strong, resolute, upright, and straight, holding to law without bending; learning excellent and quick, literary talent beautiful and outstanding—all are for use in the court and temple, truly the material of ritual vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Strong, resolute, upright, and straight, holding to law without bending; learning excellent and quick, literary talent outstanding—all are material for court and temple, truly vessels of state.

sentences.zh: 才堪將略，則拔之以禦侮，膂力驍壯，則任之以爪牙。

translations.literal: If talent suits generalship, then promote them to repel insult; if sinew and strength are fierce and strong, then employ them as claws and teeth.
translations.idiomatic: If talent suits generalship, promote them to repel insult; if sinew and strength are fierce, employ them as claws and teeth.

sentences.zh: 爰及一藝可取，亦宜採錄，眾善畢舉，與時無棄。

translations.literal: Extending to a single skill worth taking, all should also be gathered and recorded; all goods completely raised, none abandoned with the times.
translations.idiomatic: Even a single skill worth taking should be gathered and recorded; let all excellence be raised and none abandoned with the times.

sentences.zh: 以此求治，庶幾非遠。

translations.literal: By this seeking order, it is hoped it is not far.
translations.idiomatic: By seeking order in this way, good governance is hoped to be not far off.

sentences.zh: 文武有職事者，五品已上，宜依令十科舉人。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials with duties, fifth rank and above, should according to the order recommend men in ten categories.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials of fifth rank and above who hold active duties should recommend men in ten categories as ordered.

sentences.zh: 有一於此，不必求備。

translations.literal: Having one of these, completeness in all is not required.
translations.idiomatic: Possessing one of these qualities, completeness in all is not required.

sentences.zh: 朕當待以不次，隨才升擢。

translations.literal: I shall treat them out of ordinary order and promote them according to talent.
translations.idiomatic: I shall receive them out of turn and promote them according to their talents.

sentences.zh: 其見任九品已上官者，不在舉送之限。

translations.literal: Those currently serving in office of the ninth rank and above are not within the limit of recommendation and dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: Those currently serving in office of the ninth rank and above are not within the limit of recommendation.

sentences.zh: 丙申，車駕北巡狩。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the imperial carriage toured north on a hunting expedition.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen the emperor set out on a northern hunting tour.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以刑部尚書宇文㢸為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Minister of Justice Yuwen Bi was appointed Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou, Minister of Justice Yuwen Bi was made Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，勑百司不得踐暴禾稼，其有須開為路者，有司計地所收，即以近倉酬賜，務從優厚。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, an order stated that the hundred offices must not trample and ravage grain crops; where roads must be opened, the responsible offices should calculate the land's harvest and immediately compensate from nearby granaries, striving for generous treatment.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu an order stated that officials must not trample grain crops; where roads must be opened, responsible offices should calculate the land's harvest and compensate from nearby granaries, striving for generous treatment.

sentences.zh: 己亥，次赤岸澤。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, he halted at Chian Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai he halted at Chian Marsh.

sentences.zh: 以太牢祭故太師李穆墓。

translations.literal: With the great sacrifice, he sacrificed at the tomb of the former Grand Preceptor Li Mu.
translations.idiomatic: With the great sacrifice he offered sacrifice at the tomb of the former Grand Preceptor Li Mu.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，突厥啟民可汗遣子拓特勤來朝。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the fifth month, Qimin Kehan of the Turks sent his son Tuo Teqin to court.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi of the fifth month, Qimin Kehan of the Turks sent his son Tuo Teqin to court.

sentences.zh: 戊午，發河北十餘郡丁男鑿太行山，達于并州，以通馳道。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, corvée laborers from more than ten commanderies of Hebei were mobilized to cut through the Taihang Mountains, reaching Bing Province, to open an imperial road.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, corvée laborers from more than ten commanderies of Hebei were mobilized to cut through the Taihang Mountains to Bing Province, opening an imperial road.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，啟民可汗遣其兄子毗黎伽特勤來朝。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Qimin Kehan sent his elder brother's son Pilijia Teqin to court.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin, Qimin Kehan sent his elder brother's son Pilijia Teqin to court.

sentences.zh: 辛未，啟民可汗遣使請自入塞，奉迎輿駕。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Qimin Kehan sent envoys requesting to enter the passes himself to welcome the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei, Qimin Kehan sent envoys requesting to enter the passes himself to welcome the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 上不許。

translations.literal: The emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，有星孛于文昌上將，星皆動搖。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, a broom star appeared at the Upper General of Wenchang; the stars all trembled and shook.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou a broom star appeared at the Upper General of Wenchang, and the surrounding stars all trembled.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，獵於連谷。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi in the sixth month, he hunted at Liangu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi of the sixth month he hunted at Liangu.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔曰：

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, an edict stated:
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai an edict proclaimed:

sentences.zh: 聿追孝饗，德莫至焉，崇建寢廟，禮之大者。

translations.literal: In pursuing filial sacrifice, no virtue reaches higher; in reverently building sleeping temples, no ritual is greater.
translations.idiomatic: In pursuing filial sacrifice no virtue reaches higher; in reverently building ancestral temples no ritual is greater.

sentences.zh: 然則質文異代，損益殊時，學滅坑焚，經典散逸，憲章湮墜，廟堂制度，師說不同。

translations.literal: Yet substance and ornament differ by age, increase and decrease differ by time; learning was extinguished in pits and burning, classics scattered and lost, statutes sank and fell, and temple hall systems had different master teachings.
translations.idiomatic: Yet substance and ornament differ by age, and increase and decrease by time; learning was extinguished in the burning of books, classics were scattered, statutes fell into ruin, and temple systems had competing interpretations.

sentences.zh: 所以世數多少，莫能是正，連室異宮，亦無準定。

translations.literal: Therefore the number of generations is many or few and cannot be corrected; connected chambers and separate palaces also have no fixed standard.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the number of ancestral generations cannot be definitively settled, and whether chambers should be connected or separate has no fixed standard.

sentences.zh: 朕獲奉祖宗，欽承景業，永惟嚴配，思隆大典。

translations.literal: I have received and served the ancestors, reverently inheriting the glorious enterprise, eternally considering solemn matching sacrifice, thinking to elevate the great rites.
translations.idiomatic: I have received and served the ancestors, reverently inheriting their glorious enterprise, ever considering solemn sacrifice and seeking to elevate the great rites.

sentences.zh: 於是詢謀在位，博訪儒術。

translations.literal: Thereupon I consulted those in office and broadly visited Confucian learning.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon I consulted those in office and broadly sought out Confucian learning.

sentences.zh: 咸以為高祖文皇帝受天明命，奄有區夏，拯羣飛於四海，革凋敝於百王，恤獄緩刑，生靈皆遂其性，輕徭薄賦，比屋各安其業。

translations.literal: All considered that Emperor Wen the High Ancestor received Heaven's clear mandate, suddenly possessed the Middle Kingdom, rescued the flock flying in the four seas, reformed decay and exhaustion among the hundred kings, eased prisons and relaxed punishments so living creatures all attained their nature, lightened corvée and reduced taxes so every household each settled in its occupation.
translations.idiomatic: All agreed that the High Ancestor Emperor Wen received Heaven's clear mandate, suddenly possessed the Middle Kingdom, rescued the people of the four seas, reformed the decay of the hundred kings, eased prisons and relaxed punishments so all living creatures attained their nature, and lightened corvée and reduced taxes so every household settled in its occupation.

sentences.zh: 恢夷宇宙，混壹車書。

translations.literal: He restored and pacified the universe and unified carriage and writing.
translations.idiomatic: He restored and pacified the universe and unified law and script.

sentences.zh: 東漸西被，無思不服，南征北怨，俱荷來蘇。

translations.literal: East gradually extending, west covering, none thought not to submit; south campaigning, north complaining, all bore coming renewal.
translations.idiomatic: East gradually extending and west covering, none failed to submit; though some in the south resisted and some in the north complained, all eventually received renewal.

sentences.zh: 駕毳乘風，歷代所弗至，辮髮左衽，聲教所罕及，莫不厥角關塞，頓顙闕庭。

translations.literal: Driving plumed carriages and riding the wind, what former generations did not reach; braided hair and left lapel, where civilizing influence rarely reached—all without exception submitted at the passes and bowed at the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: Driving plumed carriages and riding the wind to places former generations never reached; among peoples with braided hair and left lapels, where civilizing influence rarely penetrated—all submitted at the passes and bowed at the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 譯靡絕時，書無虛月，韜戈偃武，天下晏如。

translations.literal: Interpreters never ceased in season; books had no empty month; weapons were sheathed and martial force rested; the realm was tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Interpreters never ceased their work; dispatches never missed a month; weapons were sheathed and martial force rested; the realm was tranquil.

sentences.zh: 嘉瑞休徵，表裏禔福，猗歟偉歟，無得而名者也。

translations.literal: Auspicious omens and blessed signs, inner and outer blessings and fortune—how grand, how great, none can be named!
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious omens and blessed signs, blessings inner and outer—how grand, how great, beyond naming!

sentences.zh: 朕又聞之，德厚者流光，治辨者禮縟。

translations.literal: I have also heard that where virtue is thick, light spreads; where governance is ordered, ritual is abundant.
translations.idiomatic: I have also heard that where virtue is deep, its light spreads abroad; where governance is well ordered, ritual grows abundant.

sentences.zh: 是以周之文、武，漢之高、光，其典章特立，諡號斯重，豈非緣情稱述，即崇顯之義乎？

translations.literal: Therefore Zhou's Wen and Wu, Han's Gao and Guang—their statutes and regulations stood apart, their posthumous titles were weighty; was this not following emotion and stating titles, thereby the meaning of exalted display?
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the Wen and Wu of Zhou, the Gao and Guang of Han—their statutes stood apart and their posthumous titles were weighty; was this not following emotion in bestowing titles, the meaning of exalted display?

sentences.zh: 高祖文皇帝宜別建廟宇，以彰巍巍之德，仍遵月祭，用表蒸蒸之懷。

translations.literal: The High Ancestor Emperor Wen should separately have a temple built to display his towering virtue, still following monthly sacrifice to express steaming devotion.
translations.idiomatic: The High Ancestor Emperor Wen should have a separate temple built to display his towering virtue, with monthly sacrifice to express unceasing devotion.

sentences.zh: 有司以時創造，務合典制。

translations.literal: The responsible offices should at the proper time create it, striving to accord with canonical system.
translations.idiomatic: Let the responsible offices create it at the proper time, striving to accord with canonical system.

sentences.zh: 又名位既殊，禮亦異等。

translations.literal: Moreover, name and position being different, ritual also has different grades.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, since name and position differ, ritual also has different grades.

sentences.zh: 天子七廟，事著前經，諸侯二昭，義有差降，故其以多為貴。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven's seven temples—matter recorded in former classics; feudal lords' two zhao—meaning has graduated descent; therefore taking many is considered honorable.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven's seven temples are recorded in former classics; feudal lords' two zhao reflect graduated descent; therefore taking many is considered honorable.

sentences.zh: 王者之禮，今可依用，貽厥後昆。

translations.literal: The ritual of kings—now it may be used and applied, bequeathing to later generations.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual of kings may now be used and applied, bequeathing the practice to later generations.

sentences.zh: 戊子，次榆林郡。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, he halted at Yulin Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi he halted at Yulin Commandery.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，啟民可汗來朝。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Qimin Kehan came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou, Qimin Kehan presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 己亥，吐谷渾、高昌並遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Tuyuhun and Gaochang both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai, Tuyuhun and Gaochang both sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上御北樓，觀漁于河，以宴百僚。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the emperor ascended the North Tower, observed fishing on the river, and feasted the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen the emperor ascended the North Tower, watched fishing on the river, and feasted the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，啟民可汗上表請變服，襲冠帶。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinhai, Qimin Kehan submitted a memorial requesting to change dress and adopt cap and girdle.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn's seventh month, on the day xinhai, Qimin Kehan submitted a memorial asking to change dress and adopt cap and girdle.

sentences.zh: 詔啟民贊拜不名，位在諸侯王上。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that in Qimin's bow of praise his name not be spoken; his position was above all feudal princes and kings.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that in Qimin's bow of praise his name not be spoken and placed his rank above all feudal princes and kings.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上於郡城東御大帳，其下備儀衞，建旌旗，宴啟民及其部落三千五百人，奏百戲之樂。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the emperor at the east of the commandery city ascended the great tent; below were fully prepared guards and ceremonial regalia, banners and flags raised; Qimin and his tribes of three thousand five hundred people were feasted, and the music of the hundred entertainments was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin the emperor ascended the great tent east of the commandery city with guards and ceremonial regalia below and banners raised; Qimin and his tribe of three thousand five hundred were feasted while the hundred entertainments were performed.

sentences.zh: 賜啟民及其部落各有差。

translations.literal: Qimin and his tribe were rewarded according to rank.
