translations.idiomatic: Qimin and his tribesmen were rewarded according to rank.

sentences.zh: 丙子，殺光祿大夫賀若弼、禮部尚書宇文㢸、太常卿高熲。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Grand Master for Splendid Happiness He Ruobi, Minister of Rites Yuwen Bi, and Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Gao Jiong were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, He Ruobi, Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Yuwen Bi, Minister of Rites, and Gao Jiong, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, were put to death.

sentences.zh: 尚書左僕射蘇威坐事免。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Su Wei was removed from office for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Su Wei was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 發丁男百餘萬築長城，西距榆林，東至紫河，一旬而罷，[6]死者十五六。

translations.literal: More than a million corvée laborers were mobilized to build the Great Wall, from the west at Yulin to the east at Zihe; in one ten-day period it ceased, and fifteen or sixteen out of ten died.
translations.idiomatic: More than a million corvée laborers were mobilized to build the Great Wall from Yulin in the west to Zihe in the east; the work ceased after ten days, and fifteen or sixteen out of every ten died.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，車駕發榆林。

translations.literal: On the day renwu in the eighth month, the imperial carriage departed Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu of the eighth month the imperial carriage departed Yulin.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，啟民飾廬清道，以候乘輿。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Qimin decorated huts and cleared the road to await the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou Qimin decorated huts and cleared the road to await the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 帝幸其帳，啟民奉觴上壽，宴賜極厚。

translations.literal: The emperor visited his tent; Qimin raised a cup and offered longevity; the feast and rewards were extremely generous.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor visited his tent; Qimin raised a cup and offered longevity; the feast and rewards were extraordinarily generous.

translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to the Goguryeo envoy, "Return and tell your king he should come to court without delay.

translations.idiomatic: Otherwise I shall tour his land with Qimin.

sentences.zh: 」皇后亦幸義城公主帳。

translations.idiomatic: The empress also paid a visit to Princess Yicheng's tent.

translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou Qimin Kehan returned to his frontier domain.

translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi he entered Loufan Pass.

translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin he halted at Taiyuan.

translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered construction of the Jinyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，次濟源。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei in the ninth month, he halted at Jiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei of the ninth month he halted at Jiyuan.

sentences.zh: 幸御史大夫張衡宅，宴享極歡。

translations.literal: He visited the residence of Censor-in-Chief Zhang Heng; the feast and enjoyment were extremely merry.
translations.idiomatic: He visited the residence of Censor-in-Chief Zhang Heng, where the feast was extraordinarily merry.

sentences.zh: 己巳，至于東都。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, he arrived at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi he arrived at the Eastern Capital.

translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen, Prince Yan of Qi was made Governor of Henan and Grand Master with Honorific Equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以民部尚書楊文思為納言。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Minister of the Household Yang Wensi was appointed Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou, Minister of the Household Yang Wensi was made Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on the day yisi, an edict mobilized more than a million men and women from the commanderies of Hebei to open the Yongji Canal, drawing the Qin River south to reach the Yellow River and north to connect with Zhuo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on the day yisi, an edict mobilized more than a million men and women from the commanderies of Hebei to open the Yongji Canal, channeling the Qin River south to the Yellow River and north to Zhuo Commandery.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，百僚大射於允武殿。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the hundred officials performed great archery at the Yunwu Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu the hundred officials performed great archery at the Yunwu Hall.

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, residents within the city walls were each granted ten shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao residents within the city walls were each granted ten shi of grain.

translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen, Director of the Imperial Storehouse Yuan Shou was made Director of the Palace Secretariat, and Director of the Court for Diplomatic Reception Yang Xuan'gan Minister of Rites.

translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou, Minister of Works Wei Xuan was made General of the Right Martial Guard, and Director of the Court of Judicial Review Zhang Chi Minister of the Household.

translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao of the second month, Court Herald Cui Yi was sent as envoy to Chuluo of the Western Turks to obtain blood-sweating horses.

translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou of the third month, Master Builder Yuwen Kai was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，百濟、倭、赤土、迦羅舍國並遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Baekje, Wa, Chitu, and Kala She sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, Baekje, Wa, Chitu, and Kala She sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，車駕幸五原，因出塞巡長城。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, the imperial carriage visited Wuyuan and then went beyond the frontier to tour the Great Wall.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou the imperial carriage visited Wuyuan and then went beyond the frontier to tour the Great Wall.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遣屯田主事常駿使赤土，致羅剎。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Garrison Agriculture Commissioner Chang Jun was dispatched as envoy to Chitu to obtain the Rakshasa.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin, Garrison Agriculture Commissioner Chang Jun was sent as envoy to Chitu to obtain the Rakshasa.

translations.idiomatic: [9] Editorial note marker in the source text.

translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day bingwu, Fenyuan and Linquan of Lishi and Xiurong of Yanmen were combined into Loufan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 起汾陽宮。

translations.literal: The Fenyang Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: Construction of the Fenyang Palace began.

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Prefect of Henei Zhang Dinghe was appointed General of the Left Garrison Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou, Prefect of Henei Zhang Dinghe was made General of the Left Garrison Guard.

translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao an edict stated, "Qimin Kehan of the Turks, Yili Zhendou, leading his tribes, attached at the frontier passes, followed court transformation, wished to change barbarian customs, repeatedly entered court audience, and repeatedly petitioned.

translations.idiomatic: With felt walls and fur tents his dwelling reached the utmost of wilderness and baseness; he wished for upper beams and lower eaves like common households.

translations.literal: Sincerity earnest and cutting—this is what I weight.
translations.idiomatic: His sincerity was earnest and pressing—this is what I weight.

translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen of the fifth month, Shu Commandery obtained a three-legged crow and Zhangye a black fox, one each.

translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinsi, more than two hundred thousand corvée laborers were mobilized to build the Great Wall eastward from Yugu.

translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei, Left Martial Guard General Yuwen Shu routed Tuyuhun at Mantou and Chishui.

translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou he personally sacrificed at Mount Heng, and prefects and governors of the Hebei Circuit all gathered.

translations.idiomatic: A great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 車駕所經郡縣，免一年租調。

translations.literal: Commanderies and counties passed through by the imperial carriage were granted one year of tax exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Commanderies and counties passed through by the imperial carriage received one year of tax exemption.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，徵天下鷹師悉集東京，至者萬餘人。

translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei of the ninth month, falconers from throughout the realm were summoned to the Eastern Capital; more than ten thousand arrived.

translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin a comet appeared from the Five Chariots, swept Wenchang, and extinguished at Fang.

translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi an edict exempted those on Great Wall labor from one year of land tax and corvée.

translations.idiomatic: Destined for the age, he contained the uncrowned king within himself; yet the sigh over Mount Tui passed a thousand sacrifices ago, and the beauty of his abundant virtue did not remain for a hundred generations.

sentences.zh: 永惟懿範，宜有優崇。

translations.literal: Eternally considering the fine model, he should receive generous elevation.
translations.idiomatic: Ever considering his fine model, he should receive generous elevation.

sentences.zh: 可立孔子後為紹聖侯。

translations.literal: Confucius' descendant may be established as Marquis Who Continues the Sage.
translations.idiomatic: A descendant of Confucius may be established as Marquis Who Continues the Sage.

translations.idiomatic: Let the responsible offices seek his descendants and report them upward.

translations.idiomatic: All were thereby to honor former generations and take past statutes as models.

translations.idiomatic: I have succeeded to the glorious enterprise, seeking instruction on every side; where there is broad benefit, I reverently follow the fine canon.

translations.idiomatic: I consider that Zhou combined Xia and Yin with substance and ornament greatly complete; Han possessed the realm with law and script unified; Wei and Jin followed and inherited, and their influence has not been far.

translations.literal: All should establish successors to preserve the meaning of continuing the extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: All should establish successors to preserve the meaning of continuing extinguished lines.

translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao the new forms were promulgated throughout the realm.

translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fifth year, on the day bingzi, the Eastern Capital was formally designated the Eastern Capital.

translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei an edict ordered equal-field distribution throughout the realm.

translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi the emperor returned from the Eastern Capital to the capital.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，次于閿鄉。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu in the second month, he halted at Wenxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu of the second month he halted at Wenxiang.

sentences.zh: 詔祭古帝王陵及開皇功臣墓。

translations.literal: An edict ordered sacrifice at the tombs of ancient emperors and kings and the graves of Kaihuang meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered sacrifice at the tombs of ancient emperors and kings and the graves of meritorious ministers of the Kaihuang era.

sentences.zh: 庚子，制魏、周官不得為蔭。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, it was decreed that Wei and Zhou office could not serve as privilege.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi it was decreed that Wei and Zhou office could not serve as hereditary privilege.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，赤土國遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Chitu sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou Chitu sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊申，車駕至京師。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the imperial carriage arrived at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen the imperial carriage arrived at the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，宴耆舊四百人於武德殿，頒賜各有差。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, four hundred elderly were feasted at the Wude Hall; rewards were granted according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen four hundred elderly were feasted at the Wude Hall and rewarded according to rank.

sentences.zh: 己未，上御崇德殿之西院，愀然不怡，顧謂左右曰：「此先帝之所居，實用增感，情所未安，宜於此院之西別營一殿。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, the emperor ascended the western courtyard of the Chongde Hall, somber and not at ease; he turned to those at his side and said: "This is where the former emperor dwelt; truly it increases feeling; the heart is not at ease—I should separately build one hall to the west of this courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei the emperor ascended the western courtyard of the Chongde Hall, somber and ill at ease; turning to those beside him he said, "This is where the former emperor dwelt; it truly stirs my feelings and my heart is not at ease. I should build a separate hall to the west of this courtyard.

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，制父母聽隨子之官。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, it was decreed that parents might follow their sons to office.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu it was decreed that parents might follow their sons to office.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，車駕西巡河右。

translations.literal: On the day jisi in the third month, the imperial carriage toured west along the right bank of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi of the third month the imperial carriage toured west along the right bank of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 庚午，有司言，武功男子史永遵與從父昆弟同居。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the responsible offices reported that in Wugong a man named Shi Yongzun lived together with paternal cousins from his father's generation.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu the responsible offices reported that in Wugong a man named Shi Yongzun lived together with paternal cousins of his father's generation.

sentences.zh: 上嘉之，賜物一百段，米二百石，表其門閭。

translations.literal: The emperor praised this and granted one hundred bolts of goods and two hundred shi of grain, honoring his gate and lane.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised this and granted one hundred bolts of goods and two hundred shi of grain, honoring his household at the gate and lane.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，幸扶風舊宅。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, he visited the old residence at Fufeng.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai he visited the old residence at Fufeng.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，大獵於隴西。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jihai, a great hunt was held in Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's fourth month, on the day jihai, a great hunt was held in Longxi.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，高昌、吐谷渾、伊吾並遣使來朝。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Gaochang, Tuyuhun, and Yiwu all sent envoys to court.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin, Gaochang, Tuyuhun, and Yiwu all sent envoys to present themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，次狄道，党項羌來貢方物。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, he halted at Didao; the Tangut Qiang came to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi he halted at Didao, where the Tangut Qiang came to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，出臨津關，渡黃河，至西平，陳兵講武。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, he went out through Linjin Pass, crossed the Yellow River, reached Xiping, and deployed troops for military review.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai he went out through Linjin Pass, crossed the Yellow River, reached Xiping, and reviewed the troops.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，上大獵於拔延山，長圍周亘二千里。

translations.literal: On the day yihai in the fifth month, the emperor held a great hunt at Bayan Mountain; the long encirclement extended two thousand li in circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai of the fifth month the emperor held a great hunt at Bayan Mountain, with a long encirclement extending two thousand li in circuit.

sentences.zh: [10]庚辰，入長寧谷。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, he entered Changning Valley.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen he entered Changning Valley.

sentences.zh: 壬午，度星嶺。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, he crossed Star Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu he crossed Star Ridge.

sentences.zh: 甲申，宴羣臣於金山之上。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, he feasted the multitude of officials on Mount Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen he feasted the officials on Mount Jin.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，梁浩亹，御馬度而橋壞，斬朝散大夫黃亘及督役者九人。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, at Liang Hao's bridge the imperial horse crossed and the bridge collapsed; Attendant Grand Master Huang Gen and nine overseers of labor were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu, at Liang Hao's bridge the imperial horse crossed and the bridge gave way; Attendant Grand Master Huang Gen and nine overseers of labor were executed.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾王率眾保覆袁川，帝分命內史元壽南屯金山，兵部尚書段文振北屯雪山，太僕卿楊義臣，東屯琵琶峽，將軍張壽西屯泥嶺，四面圍之。

translations.literal: The Tuyuhun king led his masses to hold Fuyuan River; the emperor separately ordered Palace Secretariat Yuan Shou to camp south at Mount Jin, Minister of War Duan Wenzhen north at Snow Mountain, Director of the Imperial Stud Yang Yichen east at Pipa Gorge, and General Zhang Shou west at Ni Ridge, surrounding them on four sides.
translations.idiomatic: The Tuyuhun king led his forces to hold Fuyuan River; the emperor ordered Palace Secretariat Yuan Shou to camp south at Mount Jin, Minister of War Duan Wenzhen north at Snow Mountain, Director of the Imperial Stud Yang Yichen east at Pipa Gorge, and General Zhang Shou west at Ni Ridge, surrounding them on four sides.

sentences.zh: 渾主伏允以數十騎遁出，遣其名王詐稱伏允，保車我真山。

translations.literal: The Tuyuhun ruler Fuyun fled out with several tens of horsemen; he sent a famous king to falsely claim to be Fuyun and hold Chewo Zhen Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The Tuyuhun ruler Fuyun fled with several tens of horsemen; he sent a noble king to pose as Fuyun and hold Chewo Zhen Mountain.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔右屯衞大將軍張定和往捕之。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, an edict ordered Right Garrison Guard General Zhang Dinghe to go capture him.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen an edict ordered Right Garrison Guard General Zhang Dinghe to go capture him.

sentences.zh: 定和挺身挑戰，為賊所殺。

translations.literal: Dinghe personally advanced to challenge in battle and was killed by the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Dinghe personally advanced to give battle and was killed by the enemy.

sentences.zh: 亞將柳武建擊破之，斬首數百級。

translations.literal: Sub-general Liu Wujian attacked and broke them, beheading several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Sub-general Liu Wujian attacked and routed them, beheading several hundred.

sentences.zh: 甲午，其仙頭王被圍窮蹙，率男女十餘萬口來降。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the Xiantou King, besieged and pressed to extremity, led more than one hundred thousand men and women to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu the Xiantou King, besieged and driven to extremity, led more than one hundred thousand men and women to surrender.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，遣左光祿大夫梁默、右翊衞將軍李瓊等追渾主，皆遇賊死之。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the sixth month, Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness Liang Mo, Right Martial Guard General Li Qiong, and others were dispatched to pursue the Tuyuhun ruler; all encountered bandits and died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou of the sixth month, Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness Liang Mo, Right Martial Guard General Li Qiong, and others were dispatched to pursue the Tuyuhun ruler; all encountered the enemy and were killed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，經大斗拔谷，山路隘險，魚貫而出。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, passing through Dadao Valley, the mountain road was narrow and dangerous; they went out in single file like a string of fish.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, passing through Dadao Valley where the mountain road was narrow and dangerous, they filed out in single line like a string of fish.

sentences.zh: 風霰晦冥，與從官相失，士卒凍死者太半。

translations.literal: Wind and sleet darkened the sky; he lost contact with attendant officials; more than half the soldiers froze to death.
translations.idiomatic: Wind and sleet darkened the sky; he lost contact with his attendants, and more than half the soldiers froze to death.

sentences.zh: 丙午，次張掖。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, he halted at Zhangye.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu he halted at Zhangye.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔諸郡學業該通、才藝優洽，膂力驍壯、超絕等倫，在官勤奮、堪理政事，立性正直、不避強禦四科舉人。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, an edict ordered the commanderies to recommend men in four categories: those whose learning is comprehensive, whose talent and arts are excellent, whose sinew and strength are fierce and surpass their peers, who are diligent in office and able to manage government affairs, and who are upright in nature and do not avoid the strong and powerful.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai an edict ordered the commanderies to recommend men in four categories: comprehensive learning, excellent talent and arts, fierce strength surpassing their peers, diligence in office and ability to manage affairs, and upright nature that does not yield to the powerful.

sentences.zh: 壬子，高昌王麴伯雅來朝，伊吾吐屯設等獻西域數千里之地。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, King Qu Boya of Gaochang came to court; the Tuyuhun Tutan She and others presented lands of the Western Regions stretching several thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi King Qu Boya of Gaochang came to court, and the Tuyuhun Tutan She and others presented lands of the Western Regions stretching several thousand li.

sentences.zh: 上大悅。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly delighted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，置西海、河源、鄯善、且末等四郡。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Xihai, Heyuan, Shanshan, and Qiemai and other commanderies were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou the commanderies of Xihai, Heyuan, Shanshan, and Qiemai were established.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上御觀風行殿，盛陳文物，奏九部樂，設魚龍曼延，宴高昌王、吐屯設於殿上，以寵異之。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the emperor ascended the Wind-Observing Traveling Hall, fully displayed cultural objects, performed the nine-section music, set out fish-dragon entertainments, and feasted the King of Gaochang and Tutan She in the hall to honor them exceptionally.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen the emperor ascended the Wind-Observing Traveling Hall, fully displayed cultural regalia, performed the nine-section music, set out fish-dragon entertainments, and feasted the King of Gaochang and Tutan She in the hall to honor them with exceptional favor.

sentences.zh: 其蠻夷陪列者三十餘國。

translations.literal: Barbarian attendants in the rows numbered more than thirty states.
translations.idiomatic: Barbarian envoys in attendance numbered more than thirty states.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, a great amnesty was granted to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu a great amnesty was granted to the realm.

sentences.zh: 開皇已來流配，悉放還鄉，晉陽逆黨，不在此例。

translations.literal: Those exiled since Kaihuang were all released to return home; Jinyang rebels were not within this case.
translations.idiomatic: Those exiled since the Kaihuang era were all released to return home; Jinyang rebels were excluded.

sentences.zh: 隴右諸郡，給復一年，行經之所，給復二年。

translations.literal: The commanderies of Longyou were granted one year of tax exemption; places passed through on the journey were granted two years.
translations.idiomatic: The commanderies of Longyou received one year of tax exemption; places passed through on the journey received two years.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁卯，置馬牧於青海渚中，以求龍種，無效而止。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day dingmao, horse pastures were established in the shoals of Qinghai Lake to seek dragon stock; when ineffective they ceased.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day dingmao, horse pastures were established in the shoals of Qinghai Lake to breed dragon stock; when this proved ineffective they were abandoned.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，車駕入長安。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei in the ninth month, the imperial carriage entered Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei of the ninth month the imperial carriage entered Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，詔曰：「優德尚齒，載之典訓，尊事乞言，義彰膠序。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day guihai, an edict stated: "Honoring virtue and esteeming the aged is recorded in canonical instruction; respectfully serving those who beg to speak manifests the meaning of the glue-and-sequoia order.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day guihai, an edict stated, "Honoring virtue and esteeming the aged is recorded in canonical instruction; respectfully heeding those who beg to speak manifests the meaning of the school order.

sentences.zh: 鬻熊為師，取非筋力，方叔元老，克壯其猷。

translations.literal: Yuxiong served as teacher—not taking sinew and strength; Fangshu the elder statesman, able to strengthen his plans.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxiong served as teacher—not for his physical strength; Fangshu the elder statesman strengthened the realm by his counsel.

sentences.zh: 朕永言稽古，用求至治，是以厖眉黃髮，更令收叙，務簡秩優，無虧藥膳，庶等臥治，佇其弘益。

translations.literal: I eternally speak of examining antiquity, using it to seek utmost order; therefore the white-browed and yellow-haired are again ordered gathered and enrolled, striving for simple rank and generous treatment, not diminishing medicinal meals, hoping to equal lying in governance and awaiting their broad benefit.
translations.idiomatic: I ever examine antiquity to seek the best governance; therefore the white-browed and yellow-haired are again gathered and enrolled, granted simple rank and generous treatment without diminishing their care, hoping they may govern from repose and bring broad benefit.

sentences.zh: 今歲耆老赴集者，可於近郡處置，年七十以上，疾患沉滯，不堪居職，即給賜帛，送還本郡；

translations.literal: Those elderly who come to assembly this year may be placed in nearby commanderies; those seventy and above with illness sunk in stagnation, unable to bear office, shall immediately be granted silk and sent back to their home commanderies;
translations.idiomatic: Elderly who come to assembly this year may be placed in nearby commanderies; those seventy and above who are gravely ill and unable to hold office shall receive silk grants and be sent back to their home commanderies;

sentences.zh: 其官至七品已上者，量給廩，以終厥身。」

translations.literal: those whose office reached seventh rank and above shall according to measure be granted grain rations to the end of their lives."
translations.idiomatic: those whose office reached seventh rank and above shall receive grain rations according to measure for the rest of their lives."

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，車駕幸東都。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi in the eleventh month, the imperial carriage visited the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi of the eleventh month the imperial carriage visited the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月癸亥朔，旦，有盜數十人，皆素冠練衣，焚香持華，自稱彌勒佛，入自建國門。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on the day guihai, the first day of the month, several tens of robbers, all wearing plain caps and white hemp clothes, burning incense and holding flowers, called themselves Maitreya Buddha, and entered through the Jianguo Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on the day guihai, the first day of the month, several tens of robbers wearing plain caps and white hemp clothes, burning incense and holding flowers, called themselves Maitreya Buddha and entered through the Jianguo Gate.

sentences.zh: 監門者皆稽首。

translations.literal: The gate guards all prostrated themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The gate guards all kowtowed.

sentences.zh: 既而奪衞士仗，將為亂。

translations.literal: Soon afterward they seized the guards' weapons and were about to create disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward they seized the guards' weapons and prepared to create disorder.

sentences.zh: 齊王暕遇而斬之。

translations.literal: Prince Yan of Qi encountered them and beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yan of Qi encountered them and had them beheaded.

sentences.zh: 於是都下大索，與相連坐者千餘家。

translations.literal: Thereupon a great search was made in the capital; more than a thousand households were implicated by association.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon a great search was made in the capital, and more than a thousand households were implicated by association.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，角抵大戲於端門街，天下奇伎異藝畢集，終月而罷。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, great grappling entertainment was held on Duanmen Street; strange skills and exotic arts from throughout the realm all gathered; it ended after a full month.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou great grappling entertainment was held on Duanmen Street; strange skills and exotic arts from throughout the realm gathered, and the spectacle continued for a full month.

sentences.zh: 帝數微服往觀之。

translations.literal: The emperor several times went in plain dress to observe.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor several times went in disguise to observe.

sentences.zh: 己丑，倭國遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Wa sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou Wa sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，武賁郎將陳稜、朝請大夫張鎮州擊流求，[11]破之，獻俘萬七千口，頒賜百官。

translations.literal: On the day yisi in the second month, Martial Guard Commandant Chen Leng and Grand Master for Court Audience Zhang Zhenzhou attacked Liuqiu, defeated it, and presented more than seventeen thousand captives; officials were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi of the second month, Martial Guard Commandant Chen Leng and Grand Master for Court Audience Zhang Zhenzhou attacked Liuqiu, defeated it, and presented more than seventeen thousand captives; officials were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔曰：「夫帝圖草創，王業艱難，咸仗股肱，協同心德，用能拯厥頹運，克膺大寶，然後疇庸茂賞，開國承家，誓以山河，傳之不朽。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, an edict stated: "When the imperial design is first established and the royal enterprise is difficult, all rely on arms and legs, jointly sharing heart and virtue, thereby able to rescue declining fortune and accept the great treasure; afterward merit is thickly rewarded, states are opened and families continued, sworn by mountains and rivers, transmitted without perishing.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao an edict stated, "When the imperial design is first established and the royal enterprise is difficult, all rely on loyal ministers sharing one heart, thereby able to rescue declining fortune and accept the great treasure; afterward merit is richly rewarded, states opened and families continued, sworn by mountains and rivers, transmitted without end.

sentences.zh: 近代喪亂，四海未一，茅土妄假，名實相乖，歷茲永久，莫能懲革。

translations.literal: In recent ages of disorder and ruin, the four seas were not unified; fiefs of soil were falsely granted, name and reality diverged; passing through this for long ages, none could punish and reform.
translations.idiomatic: In recent ages of disorder the four seas were not unified; fiefs were falsely granted and name and reality diverged; through long ages none could punish and reform this.

sentences.zh: 皇運之初，百度伊始，猶循舊貫，未暇改作，今天下交泰，文軌攸同，宜率遵先典，永垂大訓。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the imperial fortune, the hundred measures just started; still following the old practice, there was no leisure to reform; now the realm is at peace and writing and tracks are the same—it should follow the former canon and eternally bequeath the great instruction.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the imperial fortune the hundred measures had just started and still followed old practice without leisure to reform; now the realm is at peace and law and culture are one—it should follow the former canon and bequeath the great instruction.

sentences.zh: 自今已後，唯有功勳乃得賜封，仍令子孫承襲。

translations.literal: From now onward, only those with merit and achievement may be granted enfeoffment, still ordering descendants to inherit in succession.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, only those with merit and achievement may receive enfeoffment, with descendants inheriting in succession.

sentences.zh: 」丙辰，改封安德王雄為觀王，河間王子慶為郇王。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Prince Xiong of Ande was changed and enfeoffed as Prince of Guan; Prince Qing of Hejian was enfeoffed as Prince of Xun.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen Prince Xiong of Ande was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Guan, and Prince Qing of Hejian as Prince of Xun.

sentences.zh: 庚申，徵魏、齊、周、陳樂人，悉配太常。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, musicians of Wei, Qi, Zhou, and Chen were all assigned to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen musicians of Wei, Qi, Zhou, and Chen were all assigned to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，幸江都宮。

translations.literal: On the day guihai in the third month, he visited the Jiangdu Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai of the third month he visited the Jiangdu Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以鴻臚卿史祥為左驍衞大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Director of the Court for Diplomatic Reception Shi Xiang was appointed General of the Left Martial Cavalry Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi, Director of the Court for Diplomatic Reception Shi Xiang was made General of the Left Martial Cavalry Guard.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，宴江淮已南父老，頒賜各有差。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day dingwei, elders south of the Yangtze and Huai were feasted; rewards were granted according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day dingwei, elders south of the Yangtze and Huai were feasted and rewarded according to rank.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，室韋、赤土並遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao in the sixth month, Shiwei and Chitu both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao of the sixth month, Shiwei and Chitu both sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，雁門賊帥尉文通聚眾三千，保於莫壁谷。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, bandit chief Yu Wentong of Yanmen gathered three thousand men and held Mobi Valley.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen, the bandit chief Yu Wentong of Yanmen gathered three thousand men and fortified Mobi Valley.

sentences.zh: 遣鷹揚楊伯泉擊破之。

translations.literal: Falconer Yang Boquan was dispatched to attack and break them.
translations.idiomatic: Falconer Yang Boquan was dispatched to attack and rout them.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，制江都太守秩同京尹。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, it was decreed that the rank of Prefect of Jiangdu was equal to that of Capital Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin it was decreed that the Prefect of Jiangdu held rank equal to the Capital Intendant.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申，[12]刑部尚書梁毗卒。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day renshen, Minister of Justice Liang Pi died.
translations.idiomatic: In winter's tenth month, on the day renshen, Minister of Justice Liang Pi passed away.

sentences.zh: 壬子，民部尚書、銀青光祿大夫長孫熾卒。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Zhang Chi, Minister of the Household and Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Silver Seal, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi, Zhang Chi, Minister of the Household and Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Silver Seal, passed away.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，左光祿大夫、吏部尚書牛弘卒。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei in the twelfth month, Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and Minister of Civil Office Niu Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei of the twelfth month, Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and Minister of Civil Office Niu Hong died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，朱崖人王萬昌舉兵作亂，遣隴西太守韓洪討平之。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Wang Wanchang of Zhuyai raised troops in rebellion; Prefect of Longxi Han Hong was dispatched to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou, Wang Wanchang of Zhuyai raised troops in rebellion; Prefect of Longxi Han Hong was dispatched to suppress the revolt.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月壬寅，左武衞大將軍、光祿大夫、真定侯郭衍卒。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the seventh year, on the day renyin, Left Martial Guard General, Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, and Marquis of Zhending Guo Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the seventh year, on the day renyin, Left Martial Guard General, Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, and Marquis of Zhending Guo Yan passed away.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，上升釣臺，臨揚子津，大宴百僚，頒賜各有差。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei in the second month, the emperor ascended the fishing terrace, overlooking Yangzi Ford, and greatly feasted the hundred officials; rewards were granted according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei of the second month the emperor ascended the fishing terrace overlooking Yangzi Ford and greatly feasted the hundred officials, rewarding them according to rank.

sentences.zh: 庚申，百濟遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Baekje sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen Baekje sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上自江都御龍舟入通濟渠，遂幸于涿郡。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the emperor from Jiangdu boarded the dragon boat, entered the Tongji Canal, and then visited Zhuo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai the emperor from Jiangdu boarded the dragon boat, entered the Tongji Canal, and traveled to Zhuo Commandery.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔曰：「武有七德，先之以安民。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, an edict stated: "Of the seven virtues of warfare, the first is settling the people.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu an edict stated, "Of the seven virtues of warfare, the first is settling the people.

sentences.zh: 政有六本，興之以教義。

translations.literal: Of the six roots of government, the first to raise is teaching righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Of the six foundations of government, the first to cultivate is teaching righteousness.

sentences.zh: 高麗高元，虧失藩禮，將欲問罪遼左，恢宣勝略。

translations.literal: Gao Yuan of Goguryeo has failed in frontier ritual; I shall question his guilt on the Liao frontier and spread victorious strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yuan of Goguryeo has failed in frontier obligations; I shall question his guilt on the Liao frontier and spread victorious strategy.

sentences.zh: 雖懷伐國，仍事省方。

translations.literal: Though cherishing punitive expedition against the state, I still undertake provincial inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Though intending a punitive expedition, I still undertake provincial inspection.

sentences.zh: 今往涿郡，巡撫民俗。

translations.literal: Now going to Zhuo Commandery, I tour and pacify popular customs.
translations.idiomatic: Now going to Zhuo Commandery, I shall tour and pacify popular customs.

sentences.zh: 其河北諸郡及山西、山東年九十已上者，版授太守；

translations.literal: For those ninety and above in the commanderies of Hebei and in Shanxi and Shandong, appointment by tablet as prefect;
translations.idiomatic: For those aged ninety and above in the commanderies of Hebei, Shanxi, and Shandong, appointment by tablet as prefect;

sentences.zh: 八十者，授縣令。」

translations.literal: for those eighty, appointment as magistrate."
translations.idiomatic: for those aged eighty, appointment as magistrate."

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，右光祿大夫、左屯衞大將軍姚辯卒。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the third month, Yao Bian, Right Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and General of the Left Garrison Guard, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai of the third month, Yao Bian, Right Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and General of the Left Garrison Guard, died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，至涿郡之臨朔宮。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day gengwu, he arrived at the Linshuo Palace in Zhuo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's fourth month, on the day gengwu, he arrived at the Linshuo Palace in Zhuo Commandery.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，以武威太守樊子蓋為民部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi in the fifth month, Fan Zigai, Prefect of Wuwei, was appointed Minister of the Household.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi of the fifth month, Fan Zigai, Prefect of Wuwei, was made Minister of the Household.

sentences.zh: 秋，大水，山東、河南漂沒三十餘郡，[13]民相賣為奴婢。

translations.literal: In autumn, great floods; more than thirty commanderies in Shandong and Henan were inundated; the people sold one another as slaves and bondmaids.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn great floods inundated more than thirty commanderies in Shandong and Henan, and the people sold one another as slaves and bondmaids.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，底柱山崩，偃河逆流數十里。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day yimao, Mount Dizhu collapsed; the Yellow River was dammed and flowed backward for several tens of li.
translations.idiomatic: In winter's tenth month, on the day yimao, Mount Dizhu collapsed; the Yellow River was blocked and flowed backward for several tens of li.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以東平太守吐萬緒為左屯衞大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Tuo Wanxu, Prefect of Dongping, was appointed General of the Left Garrison Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, Tuo Wanxu, Prefect of Dongping, was made General of the Left Garrison Guard.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，西面突厥處羅多利可汗來朝。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei in the twelfth month, Chulu Duoli Kehan of the Western Turks came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei of the twelfth month, Chulu Duoli Kehan of the Western Turks came to court.

sentences.zh: 上大悅，接以殊禮。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased and received him with exceptional ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly pleased and received him with exceptional ceremony.

sentences.zh: 于時遼東戰士及餽運者填咽於道，晝夜不絕，苦役者始為羣盜。

translations.literal: At that time Liaodong soldiers and supply transport workers filled and choked the roads, day and night without cease; those suffering forced labor first became bandits in groups.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Liaodong soldiers and supply transport workers filled the roads day and night without cease; those suffering forced labor first turned to banditry in groups.

sentences.zh: 甲子，勑都尉、鷹揚與郡縣相知追捕，隨獲斬決之。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, an order stated that Commandants and Falconers together with districts and counties should pursue and capture; wherever captured, immediate beheading and execution.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi an order stated that Commandants and Falconers together with districts and counties should pursue and capture bandits; wherever captured, immediate execution.

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation Notes
translations.idiomatic: Textual Collation Notes

sentences.zh: 項城公韶 「韶」原作「歆」，據太平御覽

translations.literal: Duke of Xiangcheng Shao: "Shao" was originally written "Xin"; according to the Taiping Imperial Reader (hereinafter abbreviated as Imperial Reader) 106, it was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Xiangcheng Shao: "Shao" was originally written "Xin"; according to the Taiping Imperial Reader (hereinafter abbreviated as Imperial Reader), fascicle 106, it was changed.

sentences.zh: 〈以下簡稱御覽〉

translations.literal: (hereinafter abbreviated as Imperial Reader)
translations.idiomatic: Hereinafter abbreviated as Imperial Reader.

sentences.zh: 一０六改。

translations.literal: 106, changed.
translations.idiomatic: Fascicle 106 records the change.

sentences.zh: 「韶」即王韶。

translations.literal: "Shao" is Wang Shao.
translations.idiomatic: "Shao" refers to Wang Shao.

sentences.zh: 安道公李徹 「李徹」上原衍「才」字，今刪。

translations.literal: Duke of Andao Li Che: above "Li Che" the character "cai" was originally added in error; it is now deleted.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Andao Li Che: the character "cai" was originally added in error above "Li Che" and is now deleted.

sentences.zh: 徐析 「析」，南史沈客卿傳作「哲」。

translations.literal: Xu Zhe: "Zhe" in the Biography of Shen Keqing in the History of the Southern Dynasties is written "Zhi."
translations.idiomatic: Xu Zhe: in the Biography of Shen Keqing in the History of the Southern Dynasties, "Zhe" is written as "Zhi."

sentences.zh: 鳳艒 北史隋本紀下作「鳳䑽」。

translations.literal: Phoenix barge: in the Basic Annals of Sui in the History of the Northern Dynasties it is written "phoenix da."
translations.idiomatic: Phoenix barge: in the Basic Annals of Sui in the History of the Northern Dynasties the term is written "phoenix da."

sentences.zh: 艒是小船，䑽是大船。

translations.literal: Mo is a small boat; da is a large boat.
translations.idiomatic: Mo denotes a small boat; da denotes a large boat.

sentences.zh: 此處應作䑽。

translations.literal: Here it should be written da.
translations.idiomatic: Here the character should read da.

sentences.zh: 李通 即李元通，本書有傳。

translations.literal: Li Tong: that is Li Yuantong; this book has his biography.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tong: that is Li Yuantong; this book contains his biography.

sentences.zh: 一旬而罷 北史隋本紀下作「二旬而罷」。

translations.literal: Ceased in one ten-day period: in the Basic Annals of Sui in the History of the Northern Dynasties it is written "ceased in two ten-day periods."
translations.idiomatic: Ceased in one ten-day period: in the Basic Annals of Sui in the History of the Northern Dynasties it reads "ceased in two ten-day periods."

sentences.zh: 義城公主 本書中多作「義成公主」。

translations.literal: Princess Yicheng: in this book it is mostly written "Princess Yicheng."
translations.idiomatic: Princess Yicheng: elsewhere in this book the name is mostly written "Princess Yicheng."

sentences.zh: 「城」、「成」二字有時通用。

translations.literal: The characters "cheng" and "cheng" are sometimes used interchangeably.
translations.idiomatic: The characters cheng and cheng are sometimes used interchangeably.

sentences.zh: 崔毅 即崔君毅，見本書西突厥傳。

translations.literal: Cui Yi: that is Cui Junyi, see the Biography of the Western Turks in this book.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yi: that is Cui Junyi; see the Biography of the Western Turks in this book.

sentences.zh: 致羅剎 「剎」原作「罽」，據本書食貨志改。

translations.literal: Obtaining the Rakshasa: "sha" was originally written "ji"; changed according to the Treatise on Food and Money in this book.
translations.idiomatic: Obtaining the Rakshasa: "sha" was originally written "ji," changed according to the Treatise on Food and Money in this book.

sentences.zh: 大獵於拔延山長圍周亘二千里 本書禮儀志三作「詔虞部量拔延山南北周二百里」。

translations.literal: Great hunt at Bayan Mountain with long encirclement extending two thousand li: in Treatise on Rites 3 of this book it is written "ordered the Ministry of Parks to measure Bayan Mountain north and south for a circuit of two hundred li."
translations.idiomatic: Great hunt at Bayan Mountain with long encirclement extending two thousand li: in Treatise on Rites 3 of this book it reads "ordered the Ministry of Parks to measure Bayan Mountain north and south for a circuit of two hundred li."

sentences.zh: 張鎮州 本書陳稜傳作「張鎮周」。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhenzhou: in the Biography of Chen Leng in this book it is written "Zhang Zhenzhou."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhenzhou: in the Biography of Chen Leng in this book the name is written "Zhang Zhenzhou."

sentences.zh: 十月壬申 此月己丑朔，無壬申。

translations.literal: On the day renshen in the tenth month: in this month the first day was jichou; there was no renshen.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen in the tenth month: in this month the first day was jichou, so renshen is impossible.

sentences.zh: 日干有誤。

translations.literal: The day stem is in error.
translations.idiomatic: The day stem is erroneous.

sentences.zh: 三十餘郡 本書食貨志作「四十餘郡」。

translations.literal: More than thirty commanderies: in the Treatise on Food and Money in this book it is written "more than forty commanderies."
translations.idiomatic: More than thirty commanderies: in the Treatise on Food and Money in this book it reads "more than forty commanderies."
